Mais dans le format ISO, il y a une touche supplémentaire, la touche "<" et ">" à coté de Shift. J'ai du créer un layout custom pour mettre ces caractères sur Algr+W et Algr+X, mais c'est pas idéal.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Alex B", "review_title": "Comfortable and modern.", "review_text": "The keyboard itself is good, although the keycaps are not defined well and mistypes were common (I replaced them with a somewhat generic full size keyset, which despite the low profile switch, works quite well - mind the rounded keyboard corners though. That did fix my typing issue though).
Functions well, and unlike some keyboards, off is off. The 2.4GHz dongle even works for USB wake. The QMK fork that the devs works well and is easy to use.
The switch between wired/wireless/off is a bit stiff at first but wears in well. I do wish it was more pronounced to be more easy to switch between modes though.
The cable did die super quickly though, for reasons I'm not entirely sure of. I switched the keyboard between wired and wireless, and one time it just didn't want to connect back. Fixed with a replacement cable without problem.
Overall, I like this keyboard. It's as compact as a keyboard with all the necessary keys, can be.", "review_rating": ""}]

The metrics are fantastic—sleep stages, recovery scores, strain, HRV, respiratory rate, and all the deep physiological insights feel accurate and meaningful. Reviso mi Recovery y HRV cada mañana, y eso me ha ayudado a tomar decisiones más informadas sobre cuándo exigirme y cuándo bajar el ritmo.
Lo que más valoro es cómo se volvió clave para mejorar hábitos generales: sueño, energía en las mañanas y alimentación. El Journal te deja agregar tus propios factores personalizados, así que puedes cruzar tus datos con lo que realmente te importa a ti, no solo con lo genérico.
La configuración inicial toma un poco de tiempo (calibración de varios días, ajustar metas, notificaciones), pero vale la pena una vez está bien ajustado.
Punto en contra: algunas funciones como Advanced Labs (exámenes presenciales) son exclusivas de EE.UU., así que si vives fuera no podrás usarlas del todo — aunque sí puedes subir tus propios resultados de laboratorio sin problema.
En general, muy recomendado si buscas datos reales para tomar mejores decisiones sobre tu salud y bienestar día a día.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "longfellow", "review_title": "Whoop has some good stats, and some fake hype too", "review_text": "WHOOP will be at you day and night; the device is very frisky when it comes to telling you your basic health stats and behaviors. However, I would like to add a few caveats:

Reviews: [{"reviewer_name": "Janette", "review_title": "Perfect Mix of Style and Function", "review_text": "I absolutely love my Garmin watch! It\u2019s sleek, comfortable, and has so many helpful features without feeling overwhelming. I especially love being able to track my workouts, steps, sleep, and daily activity all in one place. The display is bright and easy to read, and it\u2019s comfortable enough to wear all day and night.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "LDRB", "review_title": "Finally found the Fitness Watch that works as advertised!", "review_text": "I have tested numerous \u201csmart watches\u201d in my quest to find a decent replacement for my ever faithful and reliable, Fitbit Versa 4. I purchased it almost four years ago to replace the original Fitbit Versa. But then Google took over Fitbit, and I was looking for a reliable alternative to the Fitbit products. I tried a Samsung Galaxy watch 7 that lost steps by the thousands each day. I tried an Apple Smart Watch that sometimes had to be charged more than once EVERY DAY! I tried a Parsonver (less expensive) but even though it was advertised and labeled IP 68, (indicating that it would withstand submersion in water) I actually received an email from the company before the watch was even delivered advising me to be careful even showering or washing my hands with it on! SERIOUSLY???? And the step counts were not even close to correct! Then I tried an Amazfit BIP6 (also advertised as IP 68, but clearly IS NOT) and thought I had finally found what I was looking for, until it completely malfunctioned after only 3 weeks of use. So Amazon replaced it with ANOTHER BIP6, and that one lasted almost 5 months before it began to seriously malfunction and the touchscreen no longer worked. So my new search began and I decided to give Garmin a try as my walking and swimming buddies swear by their Garmins, and the results that they get with them compare favorably to my old Fitbit. I have now only had the Garmin Vivoactive 5 for about a month, but so far, it is AWESOME! It tracks extremely well with the Fitbit, and I have had no issues whatsoever with water infiltration. If that changes, I will be back to downgrade my rating, but so far, so GREAT! This proves that you don\u2019t have to buy the most expensive models of ANY brand of fitness watch to find one that does what you need it to do. Most of them have more functions than you will ever need or use anyway. I bought separate, different color bands to customize it and love that you have a lot of choices for watch faces, so pick the one that works best for you! (Although - once again, Fitbit has a much better and more user friendly watch face selection portal!)", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Kim", "review_title": "Love me a Garmin", "review_text": "I've been using Garmin for running for years now. They've improved a lot! This one does everything I need and more. I like the body battery, sleep info. The 5 syncs up to GPS much faster than my 4 to run or walk. I love the music, however, my headphones sometimes disconnect to the watch while running. Not sure if it's the headphones or the watch. It's pretty easy to use if you've had one before. It has changed on the strength where you hit the bottom button vs tapping the watch to enter weight/reps (don't have to do that anymore, not that it was a problem). Overall I'm super satisfied. Can see it better as well with the new display.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Jared King", "review_title": "The best fitness tracker I've used", "review_text": "I'm coming from an Apple Watch Series 5. I had gotten frustrated with the battery life and sleep tracking and wanted to see if a more fitness-focused watch would be a better fit. I'm not a big runner or someone who does a lot of intense exercise, but I do like to track my exercise and sleep and get nudges to move when I've been sitting down for too long. I also like to get notifications on my wrist without needing to pull out my phone.\nCompared to the Apple Watch, the first major thing I noticed was this is nowhere close in terms of smarts. I had gotten used to Apple's smooth interface, built in microphone and speaker for voice commands, and often useful apps that can be used without needing to get my phone out. That being said, after a few days I can confidently say that I don't need them. I would argue that Garmin knows what this is and what it is not - it's a fitness device first and foremost, and everything else comes second. And on that basis they nailed it - the fitness tracking has been excellent and noticeably better than the Apple Watch especially in sleep tracking. I also much prefer their approach to goals, which tracks exercise over the course of a week rather than focusing specifically on individual days. Whenever I was sick or had a down day I would feel guilty if I didn't close all of my rings on my Apple Watch, but I don't feel that same pressure with the Garmin. I do miss being able to use voice commands with my watch, but I could have gotten a more expensive Garmin if I really wanted that, and I don't think it's worth it for me.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amazon Customer", "review_title": "Good watch", "review_text": "This is my first Garmin. Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Jack", "review_title": "Packed with Upgraded GPS L1 & L5 tracking & 4 Med Sensors", "review_text": "A lot of Good things to say about this Sport watch. I don't know about reliability , but for accuracy, for med data like heart Beat, & Oxygen I measured those against my Oxi meter & Blood Pressure Kit and data was very accurate. The watch faces however, are not as Felxible/adjustable as others where some watches actually allows you to create them. This watch has a L1 & L5 GPS system which is highly reliable and unlike many other watches especially under $150 , will find a GPS signal within 3- 5 seconds per my test. It also has 4 sensors to give you more reliable health readings. It has as many, sleep mode that measures many factors. I had a $250 sport watch that did the same, (Recently died) and the results were within boundaries of the more expensive watch, but it did not track snoring . Battery life seems to be good though I only had this watch about 4 days , but I have been busy testing this one and another watch BVLRKSC . I tested distance accuracy with my Odo on my electric bike on both watches. The resutls were pretty good. You can spend a lot more $$ on other watches that have the same upgraded functions that the Pro 3 has, and not be any more accurate. Both watches are comfortable, though this watch tends to lean on less color, and less choices for dial display. I am leaning more on the other watch just for its Dial faces and easy choices , but its a tough decision because this one really packs a wallop for upgraded tech. The other watch you have to go into the App to sync up a GPS signal, that transfers to the watch (You don't have to have the phone with you after that) in order to use GPS within seconds, otherwsie you wait 3 -5 minutes. This watch connections to GPS within 3-5 seconds thanks to the L1 & L5 GPS. One can hardly go wrong with these watches. The only thing that I have read on this watch was poor follow up with the manufacture if you experience problems etc. Hopefully that's been addressed.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "KK", "review_title": "Fantastic for the price.", "review_text": "So I am coming to this watch from an absolutely ancient Apple Watch 2. The battery on that finally bit the bullet and wouldn't charge anymore.
Not wanting to spend the 200+ dollars on a new lower end Apple Watch, I decided to take the chance on this one after reading reviews and doing some research.
First in terms of looks - This looks fantastic. The watch faces are modern and there are so many options - from more minimal to hyper functional - displaying most of the metrics you would want to see in a smart watch/fitness tracker. I got the dark grey version and it is very clean. There is minimal branding with small text displaying "CMF by Nothing" on the rim around the watch face, but it is barely noticeable. The screen is bright, and I always have mine set on adaptive brightness. I haven't had any issues seeing the screen during a bright day yet.
The biggest plus for me is battery life! This thing will not die! The biggest issue I had with the Apple Watch was the battery life. Mine would die near the end of the day, even when the battery wasn't cooked from age. I had to constantly have it on the charge at the end of the day and never used its sleep tracking because the watch would be dead in the morning if I did. This definitely does not have that problem. I've worn this watch 3 days in a row without a charge, and even with pretty frequent use/checking it was still at 60ish percent. I usually charge it by putting it on the charger while I'm getting ready for work in the morning. It will go from 80ish percent to 95+ in the time I'm getting ready. I'm looking at the battery life right now - it is 2:30 in the afternoon and I've had the watch on me since I charged this morning around 6:30 - 95% battery life!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Aradhya", "review_title": "Great for the price!", "review_text": "The cmf watch 3 pro is an amazing stylish smartwatch. I’ve had it for a few months and this is my honest review. The quality of the app is unlike any, CMF or Nothing gives a great app experience that makes it very easy for users to work. The heart rate monitoring is absolutely amazing and is right most of the time. Features of the watch such as features work MOST of the time, not Apple Watch quality level, but potentially some of the best for 80$. The water resistance is great, I submerged it in water and noticed that speakers and microphone still worked great. The watch has many sizes to fit all. Certain features such as the news feel more like a gimmick than a feature. Now since I use an iPhone, many features don’t work too well because of how closed IOS is. This means that the software experience while is refined has multiple instances of not working. Bluetooth may disconnect sometimes, notifications can be buggy (not showing emojis or pictures) which some other watches at the same price do actually show. Overall this watch is amazing for the price point so its accuracy, material quality, ESPECCIALY at its price point. This is a great recommend to those who would like a smartwatch, but aren’t too serious about its features.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Fortiskev", "review_title": "Cheap Price but Great Smartwatch with Some Limitations", "review_text": "I decided to buy a new smartwatch because my previous one had died, wasn't charging so I saw this and did my check to see if it was worth buying.
Pros
Falls under 100USD so great price
Long Battery life 3 days use with everything on, wake on wrist, AOD, all the tracking everything.
No connectivity issues, gets all my notifications and everything no issues
all in one", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Zach", "review_title": "Practical but disappointing.", "review_text": "I wanna like the watch, but I immediately ran into a lot of limitations. Reviews: [{"reviewer_name": "Janette", "review_title": "Perfect Mix of Style and Function", "review_text": "I absolutely love my Garmin watch! I purchased it almost four years ago to replace the original Fitbit Versa. But then Google took over Fitbit, and I was looking for a reliable alternative to the Fitbit products. I tried a Samsung Galaxy watch 7 that lost steps by the thousands each day. I tried an Apple Smart Watch that sometimes had to be charged more than once EVERY DAY! I tried a Parsonver (less expensive) but even though it was advertised and labeled IP 68, (indicating that it would withstand submersion in water) I actually received an email from the company before the watch was even delivered advising me to be careful even showering or washing my hands with it on! SERIOUSLY???? And the step counts were not even close to correct! Then I tried an Amazfit BIP6 (also advertised as IP 68, but clearly IS NOT) and thought I had finally found what I was looking for, until it completely malfunctioned after only 3 weeks of use. So Amazon replaced it with ANOTHER BIP6, and that one lasted almost 5 months before it began to seriously malfunction and the touchscreen no longer worked. So my new search began and I decided to give Garmin a try as my walking and swimming buddies swear by their Garmins, and the results that they get with them compare favorably to my old Fitbit. I have now only had the Garmin Vivoactive 5 for about a month, but so far, it is AWESOME! It tracks extremely well with the Fitbit, and I have had no issues whatsoever with water infiltration. If that changes, I will be back to downgrade my rating, but so far, so GREAT! This proves that you don\u2019t have to buy the most expensive models of ANY brand of fitness watch to find one that does what you need it to do. Most of them have more functions than you will ever need or use anyway. I bought separate, different color bands to customize it and love that you have a lot of choices for watch faces, so pick the one that works best for you! (Although - once again, Fitbit has a much better and more user friendly watch face selection portal!)", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Kim", "review_title": "Love me a Garmin", "review_text": "I've been using Garmin for running for years now. They've improved a lot! This one does everything I need and more. I like the body battery, sleep info. The 5 syncs up to GPS much faster than my 4 to run or walk. I love the music, however, my headphones sometimes disconnect to the watch while running. Not sure if it's the headphones or the watch. It's pretty easy to use if you've had one before. It has changed on the strength where you hit the bottom button vs tapping the watch to enter weight/reps (don't have to do that anymore, not that it was a problem). Overall I'm super satisfied. I would argue that Garmin knows what this is and what it is not - it's a fitness device first and foremost, and everything else comes second. Category: Clothing, Shoes & Jewelry,Men,Watches,Wrist Watches
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Susan Bewley", "review_title": "Great Upgrade from Galaxy Watch 5", "review_text": "As someone who loved her Galaxy Watch 5, I was very excited to finally upgrade to the Watch 9. My old watch finally died this week, which seemed like perfect timing with the new coming out (though I wish I could have taken advantage of pre-order deals but alas). Luckily, I was able to get a replacement pretty quickly and in a color I liked as well.
First, I have to say that while I love my watch, it was a bit of a panic attack at first, as the setup was way different from my first watch. As someone who mostly used her watch for productivity tasks, step tracking, and heart rate monitoring during workouts, I found all the new fitness-tracking features extremely overwhelming. I almost sent it back because I wasn't sure if I wanted all these options. Since I didn't want to put up with the lack of functionality and durability of the Fitbit, I decided to stick it out and just turn off some of the features. It was better to have them in case I wanted them later.
Once I got my watch working, though, I was very impressed. The fit has been great and it seems more durable than my old watch. [{"reviewer_name": "Jeff S.", "review_title": "Great budget smartwatch", "review_text": "After 17 years in the Apple ecosystem, I recently switched from an iPhone to a Samsung S26 Ultra so I needed a watch that worked with my new Android phone to replace my Apple Watch. The band is soft and comfortable (I'm not sure if there are many replacement bands to customize your FIT like are available for Apple Watches). I have been using google health to track my calories and set specific goals for some of my macros I'm trying to hit. Unfortunately, the samsung health app doesn't get this specific and just gives you the suggested daily intake as a metric rather than letting you set your own. What sucks more is that these two apps don't sync with each other. So now I have 2 seperate apps to track my health. All in all. Its really a fantastic little gadget. (I don't want to pay smart watch prices.)
Out of the box, the Fit 3 was in Spanish, but when I put it on the charger, it reverted to English. It stayed English until I got a new phone and had to reset the tracker in order to pair it with the new phone. The tracker reverted to Spanish and putting it on the charger did not change that this time. I pressed the top option on the device's screen and got to choose from a whole list of languages. I chose English, but this is where someone who wants another language will find it.
The charge on this item is supposed to last up to 13 days. I've had this device for 3 months, and I got 6 days out of each charge (7 if I let the device die) for the first 2 months or so. My Fit 3 charges from 20% to 70% in about 20 minutes and to 100% in about an hour. Title: Garmin Forerunner® 165, Running Smartwatch, 43mm, Black
Description: Easy-to-use running smartwatch with built-in GPS for pace/distance and wrist-based heart rate; brilliant AMOLED touchscreen display with traditional button controls; lightweight design in 43 mm size
Category: Electronics,Wearable Technology,Smartwatches
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "HwnMelody", "review_title": "Good economy sport watch", "review_text": "Best purchase I made all year. I started running recently, training for a marathon at the end of the year. I used to spend my time trying to take my run time and miles to try and calculate my pace. Now I just look at my watch and all the metrics are right there for me. It can take all of my runs and predict my race times. I no longer have to guess how many miles I put in for my run or for the entire week. It gives you heart rate, HRV, VO2 Max, step counts, sleep scores and suggested training plans. Battery life is good. If you’re running a lot and using the GPS, the battery will drain faster. I tend to charge after my long run.
If you’re in training, and looking for a good sports watch, consider this one.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Christopher Henry", "review_title": "13 days battery life", "review_text": "Ok so I purchased this Garmin 165 watch for just $200. So the price was excellent. It has a nice bright amoled screen and has a good build quality. However, I only use this watch as a fitness, wellness and running watch. That is, I turned off the notifications. I don't see the point of trying to read a notification or message on a watch face when my phone is right next to me. So with notifications turned off I got 13 days of battery life before the watch went down to 9%. I also do not have on the "always on display". With this set up you can get 13 days of regular (non smart watch) use. This is what I wanted the most, a descent battery. So having to just charge the watch every 2 weeks or twice a month is really great. I also wore the watch every day and did walking workouts. One thing to note : I DID NOT SLEEP WITH THE WAATCH ON... I do not know if that helped the battery life but I generally do not sleep with any watched or rings or anything restrictive when I sleep.. I need comfort... lol.. But I did sleep one night with it and it was comfortable.. just not my thing... but great watch, connected to GPS is seconds, gives good info in the app and is comfortable. Highly recommend for someone who is into fitness... it can track most activities like running, walking, swimming, hiking, trail run, in door run etc.. most general activities.... look... there is really no need to go out an buy a $500 or $900 watch.. this one does the job at $200.. no point getting a watch that gives you tons of stats that you will not use or understand... if you do triathlons or want those pretty maps on the watch then by all means get the more expensive watch but if you just want to keep healthy and run.. then this watch is prefect..", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "BigRon", "review_title": "Great running watch", "review_text": "I’ve been running for over 20 years and have only ever used by Apple Watch and before that my timex iron man running watch. Getting a dedicated running watch like this is a game changer. So many more metrics and options to use while running and to review after running has really made me a better runner. I’ve had this watch about 8 months now and have had no issues at all. Heart rate functions great for all day monitoring. I have used a chest strap for a long time for activity monitoring. Even w this watch chest strap heart rate monitoring is the only way to go for accuracy. Wrist based monitors are ok, but if your training and trying to hit certain heart rate zones I would to recommend a chest strap. W that said. Compared to my Apple Watch this wrist based monitor is better. It locks on faster and seems to be pretty accurate. Screen is easy to see in bright sunlight and inside as well. U get access to free training plans within the Garmin app which is easy
to use but looks a bit outdated. W this watch you don’t get training load or training status or readiness like the more expensive Garmin watches but u do get training effect for each workout for aerobic and anaerobic metrics. I use iPhone and have the watch set to notify for calls and text only and the rest of my phone notifications are send silently to my notification widget on the watch which I love. Helps minimize distractions. The watch stays connected very good to my iPhone 14 and always syncs w the Garmin app. The strap the comes w it is comfortable but I did switch it out for a nylon strap which I feel is better and lighter. I would highly recommend this watch for its functionality, metrics and price when u can find it on sale. Overall Garmin products are over priced. But having a worry free experience when paired w an iPhone and accurate training metrics is worth it for this particular device.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Michael", "review_title": "Garmin Forerunner 165", "review_text": "As a half marathon runner training for a full marathon, I wanted this watch to be my full time training partner (and bully at times..lol). I notice a large improvement from my previous watch (apple watch series 10 I believe). It has great tracking for mileage, pace, HR, and a more accurate Vo2max. The sleep metrics are detailed well, I just wish the alarms were louder. The set up was very easy to complete, just create a Garmin account, sync your watch, and boom, you’re in. The battery life is insane, up to a week of battery for me (depending on usage) and very fast to charge. I had a $250 sport watch that did the same, (Recently died) and the results were within boundaries of the more expensive watch, but it did not track snoring . The only thing that I have read on this watch was poor follow up with the manufacture if you experience problems etc. Hopefully that's been addressed.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "KK", "review_title": "Fantastic for the price.", "review_text": "So I am coming to this watch from an absolutely ancient Apple Watch 2. I've worn this watch 3 days in a row without a charge, and even with pretty frequent use/checking it was still at 60ish percent. I usually charge it by putting it on the charger while I'm getting ready for work in the morning. It will go from 80ish percent to 95+ in the time I'm getting ready. [{"reviewer_name": "Maria Richelmi", "review_title": "**Perfect case if you want protection without hiding the color of your iPhone**", "review_text": "⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ **Perfect case if you want protection without hiding the color of your iPhone**
I bought this case for my new iPhone 17 Pro - Cosmic Orange because I wanted good protection but didn't want a bulky case that would hide the Cosmic Orange color of the phone.
I really like it! The Crystal Orange color matches the Cosmic Orange of my iPhone so well that, when the case is on, it almost looks like the phone doesn't have a case at all — which is exactly what I was hoping for.
The case feels sturdy and provides good protection while still being very slim. It also looks really nice on the phone and doesn't take away from its original design.
Installation was very easy. You put the top two points of the phone into the case first and then push the bottom of the phone into place. It snapped in easily and securely.
Another plus was the delivery — I received it the very next day after ordering.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "DailyBuyer", "review_title": "Great quality", "review_text": "Really love this case. It fits the phone perfectly without adding extra bulk, keeps the original look of the phone visible, and offers great grip and drop protection. Excellent quality!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Richard", "review_title": "Good value", "review_text": "This case looks much better in front of you than a picture can render. I have the Product Red iPhone XR and this is the red case. The color comes very close to the color of the aluminum frame and looks like part of the phone. At first glance it doesn't look like there is any case at all! The red color is a shiny, metallic red as opposed to the matte red color of the iPhone frame. It does not clash where the phone's color can be seen in the cutouts and it nicely compliments the color on the back of the phone! Contrary to what another reviewer said, this case does indeed have a lip for basic screen protection. If you lay your phone face down on a perfectly flat surface with this case on, the screen will not contact anything. That being said, it is minimal by design. If you think you may be tossing your expensive phone around in places where the screen could be impacted perhaps you would be better served with a more robust case. This case is a great value for what it is! It complements the phone's styling. It will protect your phone from scratches on the back and sides. I had an iPhone 6 Plus with no screen protector installed on the glass for four years. The only protection was the lip provided by the various cases I used. The glass never got more than the most superficial, barely visible marks in that length of time. Totally worth it to me for the arguably better user experience of the naked glass screen. Even the most pricey tempered glass screen protectors do not match the buttery smooth touchscreen experience in my opinion. My fingers do not slide the same way. Anyway, the glass on the iPhone XR is significantly tougher than previous phones and I don't anticipate a problem. I offer that information only to illustrate that, with proper care in handling, you can rock an inexpensive, minimalist case with no issues. It should be noted, as another reviewer has said, that the back of this case is NOT perfectly clear. The phone can be seen but there is a pattern or texture which is noticeable if you hold it to the light just right. Not a deal breaker at all for me. You can still showcase the beauty of your XR with this case but it could be an issue if you require a perfectly clear back. I think this pattern may have something to do with durability and I doubt it will be an issue to most users. There is a color coordinated lip to protect the camera lens and I love the custom color coordinated cutout for the flash and mic modules in the back. So many XR cases simply have a huge opening that looks like it was designed for a dual camera setup. I like the extra attention to detail. One caveat: The fit is snug. If you are like me and frequently take you case off for thorough cleaning or want to rock a different case for that day, care should be taken when removing this case. The iPhone's aluminum frame is slippery and you could launch your phone out of your hands! I bought several cases together to compare. The Ranvoo case is nearly identical to this one. That one is much easier to remove because it is ever so slightly thinner. It has the same attention to detail in the cutouts and the same pattern in the "clear" back. The tradeoff is there is virtually no raised lip to protect the screen which is why it's easier to remove. Both products are good for what they are. This Torras case is a remarkably nice product for the money. With proper care it could be the only case you need but at this price, it will be a nice option in your iPhone's wardrobe.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Flamingrickshaw", "review_title": "Looks Great!!!", "review_text": "Snug fit with my iPhone 17 Pro so it protects my phone quite well and I’m quite happy with it. Seems to be durable as I have dropped my phone a couple of times I’m very surfaces and so far, I haven’t seen a crack anywhere. Quality seems to be solid so far but only time will tell. Feels very slick and smooth, but maybe too smooth as it has been known to slide quite easily. There is a protector for the front screen (which I did not purchase), but I decided against it as I have discovered front screens reduce the phone‘s ability to detect commands with my finger after time has progressed and dirt/detritus builds up behind the screen after a certain length of time. I was concerned at first that the edge of the case on the back where the lenses are located would raise the phone too high and not allow charging when the phone was laying down on a charge mat, but that was not the case. Although, I did discover that exact positioning is important as just laying it down doesn’t always mean the phone is charging. So, I had to make sure to watch the screen when I wanna charge to make sure the mat and the phone aren’t position to charge when needed.
All in all, this is a pretty solid product and I haven’t seen any yellowing in the plastic case as of yet, but it’s only been a couple months since I’ve been using it so maybe after a year I’ll reassess again. If there was one thing that would bug me about this case, is the raised lip of the back of the case surrounding the lenses. There was already a raised area on the phone for those lenses and this case just makes it that much more pronounced. I can only guess that the raised lip area on the back of the case is to further protect the lenses, but that also makes it harder for easy positioning for charging, and makes the phone bulkier when being placed into a pocket or bag. Still, this protects my phone and does what I want it to do so the raised area on the back is a minor issue that I can live with for now. Would I get another one? Hmmmm, maybe. Too early to tell at this point. But I won’t say no if something better comes out on the market.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Caperton Family", "review_title": "Exactly what my stepdaughter wanted for her new phone.", "review_text": "Good quality and easy to install for my stepdaughter’s new phone. She wanted a clear case to showcase her new phone and she added a picture to it behind the case. Title: ESR for iPhone 15 Case for MagSafe, Anti-Yellowing, Clear
Description: Compatibility: only for iPhone 15; full functionality maintained via precise speaker and port cutouts and easy-press buttons
Category: Cell Phones & Accessories,Cases, Holsters & Sleeves,Basic Cases
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Kyle", "review_title": "Slim and reliable iPhone case with good protection", "review_text": "I’m very happy with the ESR iPhone 14 Pro Case. It has a clean design, feels durable, and provides good protection while keeping the phone slim. I like that it supports MagSafe, making it easy to use with my MagSafe accessories and chargers.
The clear black design also looks great because it lets the original iPhone design show while still adding protection. The case feels sturdy without adding too much bulk.
Pros:
Slim and lightweight design
Good protection for everyday use
MagSafe compatibility works well
Clear design looks great
Durable build quality", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Robert H.", "review_title": "Legit Military-Grade protection without the "Brick" feel!", "review_text": "If you’re tired of cases that claim to be "tough" but feel like cheap plastic, or "rugged" cases that make your phone too big to fit in a pocket, the ESR Military-Grade Shockproof Case is the upgrade you’ve been looking for. I’ve tested a lot of MagSafe cases, and this one feels like it was engineered, not just manufactured.
Protection That Isn’t Just Marketing
The first thing you notice is the Air-Guard corners. They aren’t just decorative; they create a visible cushion that actually absorbs impact. I’ve already had one "heart-stop" moment where my phone slid off a high counter onto a tile floor, and it literally bounced. Not a scratch on the phone or the case. The "Military-Grade" label actually feels earned here.
The MagSafe Connection (HaloLock)
ESR’s magnets (they call it HaloLock) are notoriously strong—often stronger than the official Apple cases. 
• The "Snap": When you bring it near a charger or car mount, it grabs hold with a very secure click.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "David O.", "review_title": "Good phone cover", "review_text": "Nice, well made, better than original provided by Apple when phone purchased.
Quick delivery. easy to install, fits great, great buttons", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "The Famous", "review_title": "Lasted two years before it started falling apart", "review_text": "I’m a happy camper when it comes to this case.
I had my old one for two years before the plastic started to fall apart.
Initially, I got a different case for five dollars that even came with a screen protector and I thought to myself this is such a great deal, when I tried it the magnetic component of the case failed miserably so I returned it and got this case again for about $13 which is the same price I paid for this case two years ago.
You get what you pay for. This is a great case that served me for two years and the magnetic component of it is very strong.
In the pictures you can see the two years old case next to the brand new one.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Gib", "review_title": "Great phone case option, just keep in mind that it does yellow over time.", "review_text": "Firstly, I love the feel of this case, it's honestly a case I continue to buy and buy again. Since it perfectly fits my iPhone 15 plus, the installation is easy. This particular model doesn't have a kickstand, but I'm okay with that since I have a MagSafe pop socket. Did I mention MagSafe? I LOVE MagSafe compatible phone cases, it makes accessories easier to use, especially since I don't have to take the case off and on again. My phones fallen a multitude of times, and hasn't had any damage to the body of the phone. In terms of overall protection, screen protection is sound, especially from someone like me who doesn't use a phone screen! My only flaw with this however, is that the case does yellow, as I've mentioned this is the case I continue to "buy and buy" over again and again...", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amazon Customer", "review_title": "Quality case that saves phone every time", "review_text": "Amazing quality case at a great price! Super easy to install, and it helps protect the screen and body of the phone very well. Sleek design and it’s been dropped numerous times and always saved the phone! The clear plastic does eventually turn yellow, but that’s only because I rarely clean it/use it all the time, and even then, it takes a long time to show wear. Happy with quality and material!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "JL", "review_title": "Great quality, Great Customer support", "review_text": "I first bought this case 2 years ago and the case didn't yellow for an entire year with rough use. I've dropped my phone multiple times and it did an amazing job protecting it from any damage. Installing the case was easy, with a satisfying click. It did feel looser than other cases I've used, but it definitely anything but. The case is smooth plastic, but is very grippy when it's clean.
My first case lasted one year before it started to yellow. This was after very rough use, with constant exposure to UV and skin oils. However, the main reason I reached out to customer support was due to the glue failing. But, the warranty process was extremely easy. I submitted a request with the issue and photos and they quick to respond and promptly sent out a replacement. With the second one, I took care to clean it more often and it was much less yellow in the same timespan as the last one. I would say it is fairly durable for the price point.
I would be still using this case if not for the new one I bought: their Stash kickstand variant of the case. Highly recommend if you're looking for a simple clear case, and the brand as well.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amazon Customer", "review_title": "Quality case for very cheap", "review_text": "Fit great on my iPhone 13. Button pressing is good, very easy to install, nice case", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "chiquipou", "review_title": "Très bonne coque de téléphone", "review_text": "La coque est super, légère, belle et à l’air solide ! Pour l’instant je n’ai pas eu l’occasion de voir la solidité après une chute. J’éditerais si besoin après son premier envol !
Je n’ai pas pu évaluer la qualité du MagSafe car n’ayant pas de chargeur à induction. Pareil j’éditerais au besoin si j’en ai un un de ces quatre.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Sylvia", "review_title": "WOW - what an amazing case for my phone", "review_text": "Absolutely love this case, it is sturdy, excellent quality, just perfect.
The ESR brand is also excellent - I have made an account, registered my case, even though bought on Amazon and not direct - and now have points enough for 10 dollars off my next case and I have a 2 year warranty.
What is not to love!!
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED 5*****", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Noah Bohorquez", "review_title": "Excellent product!", "review_text": "Item arrived on time and was exactly as decribed. [{"reviewer_name": "Kaye", "review_title": "Charges fast", "review_text": "Charges fast and doesn't take as much room as my tower.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "eugene m quinn", "review_title": "Great charger", "review_text": "Works great", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amazon Reviewer", "review_title": "Good charger - Gets a bit warm at Max Output - Extremely Flexible All in One Travel Brick", "review_text": "This is a handy charger to have around for traveling as it can power up a pretty decent laptop and or your cellphone and or your Bluetooth earbuds all at once. I particularly appreciate the front-facing ports. My 140W WeGear charger has a display that briefly shows the exact wattage being drawn through each port, which is useful and interesting. However, its charging ports are underneath. Because most wall outlets are too low for me to see the bottom of the charger, connecting a cable after it is already plugged in becomes an exercise in playing Braille. I generally have to attach the cables first and then plug the entire charger into the wall.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Mitra", "review_title": "A compact 100W charger that actually charges my MacBook Pro fast", "review_text": "I have been testing this Wegear 100W charger for a couple of weeks, mostly with my MacBook Pro and a few other USB PD devices like cameras. Here are my thoughts.
The first thing I noticed is how small this charger is. It is smaller than the 140W charger that came with my MacBook Pro, which made it an easy swap for travel and for keeping on my desk without taking up much space.

The battery went from low to full in a short amount of time, right around what I expect from the stock charger. One thing to note is that this unit runs hotter than the Apple charger while it is powering the laptop. That makes sense since the MacBook Pro normally uses a 140W supply, so this 100W unit is likely working near its top capacity to keep up. There is no display or indicator on the charger to show exact wattage, so I could not confirm the exact output, but the charging speed and battery results told me it was doing its job well.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Agtstack", "review_title": "Awesome", "review_text": "The Good
True High-Speed: Powers a dead smartphone to 50% in under fifteen minutes.Smart Power Sharing: Intelligently splits wattage across multiple devices without dropping connections.Ultra-Compact: Uses GaN technology to pack massive power into a tiny, travel-friendly footprint.Secure Fit: Rigid folding prongs snap firmly into place and do not sag out of loose wall outlets.
The Bad
Blocks Adjacent Plugs: The wider body shape can slightly overlap tight power strips.LED Is Too Bright: The blue indicator light glows vividly in a pitch-black bedroom at night.
Full Breakdown
I have gone through dozens of cheap wall bricks over the years, most of which claim to feature "fast charging" but fail miserably the moment you plug in a second device. I bought this premium GaN charger to streamline my travel kit and act as a reliable daily hub for my power-hungry gear. After a month of heavy use, it has proven to be an absolute powerhouse that lives up to every bit of its marketing.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Greenspot Gardener", "review_title": "Fast charging, Big Power, multi device", "review_text": "Wegear 100 W GaN USB C charger block powers up my devices faster than I've ever seen! I can have multiple devices plugged in and all charging at the same time! I have tried power blocks that say they are higher power and faster charging but they always seem to give me trouble. I carefully tried new cords and older cords with my newest smartphones and some that were older and having trouble receiving a charge, and continuing to charge.
The newest cords worked instantly, my phone lit up with super fast charging or turbocharging with greatly reduced times showing for full charge. I carefully date and label my cords so I don't get them mixed up with older chords that just don't seem to work unless plugged into a much older lower power charging device.
Some of my oldest smartphones that were difficult to charge are now useful again as backup cameras, audio players, streaming devices at home so my newest devices can be fully charged when I leave for the day.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Kevin H.", "review_title": "Great charger that can be brought along for the trip.", "review_text": "I was skeptical that something this slim could pack 100 watts, but the wegear charger proved me wrong within the first use. It charges my devices noticeably faster than the stock brick that came with my laptop, and it does so without turning into a hand warmer in the process. Even after an hour of charging my laptop and phone simultaneously, the block stays cool to the touch, which says a lot about the GaN tech doing its job properly.

[{"reviewer_name": "Manuel", "review_title": "Great charger", "review_text": "I've been very impressed with the Apple MagSafe 25W Wireless Charger. The other issue is weight. The device is small and surprisingly light, but that means if you pick up your charging phone, the charger comes with it. Great in a car, but it won't work there. Terrible on a nightstand or desk. I'm constantly prying off the charger just so I can use the phone.

📦 ¿Qué nos encontramos en la caja?
De primeras, lo mejor de este producto es que es un pack doble. Te vienen dos bases de carga inalámbrica magnética de color violeta oscuro (tampoco es demasiado oscuro).

El chasis es metálico, lo que le da un toque premium muy limpio, y el cable viene integrado con conector USB-C y un acabado trenzado que se nota bastante resistente al trote diario (dobleces, tirones en la mochila, etc.).", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amazon Customer", "review_title": "Great if your charge port has commitment issues", "review_text": "I use this with my iPhone 8 because sometimes the charge port is finicky so I have to use wireless charging, and I gave the second one in the 2 pack to my cousin who has an iPhone 14 Pro Max. Title: NOCO GENIUS1 1A 6/12V Smart Battery Charger, Trickle Charger & Maintainer
Description: MEET THE GENIUS1 — Similar to our G750, just better. It's 35% smaller and delivers over 35% more power. It's the all-in-one charging solution - battery charger, battery maintainer, trickle charger, plus desulfator.
Category: Automotive,Tools & Equipment,Jump Starters, Battery Chargers & Portable Power,Battery Chargers
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Shane", "review_title": "Works as intended", "review_text": "So I just bought a brand new one two years, but it’s because I never registered the warranty for our first one. This is basically a one piece kit that is a great starter for battery charging for most kinds of automotive and marine batteries. It’s very simple to use, and the one reason our last one stopped functioning is because of built in fail safes. In this case: my wife and I were washing our camper and this got wet and then got some dirt on it, it got through the water resistant seal and the charger could detect this. The great news is the charger will literally cease to function if it has become damaged. It will give a flashing red light, and you cannot put it into Force Charge mode. The only downside is unless you have a multimeter, you may not know that it has become damaged internally. I figured it out because of the mode not working, and it wouldn’t charge any batteries. The fuse was fine. So make sure you register this when you get it. It does the job and the only way you know it’s working is because of the status light, as it is beyond quiet. It’s basically a plug with the clamps for the battery terminals, so it is easy to store and carry around. I highly recommend this charger if you need something simple without a lot of functionality, just don’t leave it exposed to the elements.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "C. Nekritz", "review_title": "Little Miracle", "review_text": "Okay, I did NOT expect this little thing to work, but it did and might for you IF you have patience.
My Grandfather who was MoAT (Mechanic of All Things) owned back in the day what I thought were REAL chargers, they were so big and heavy they had to be put on wheels and rolled around, they had giant switches that'd illuminate and while I'm probably purely imagining this they were plugged into 220-volt outlets. This thing fits in the palm of my hand, just as pictured, smaller than most mobile phones. "Huh," I said, "this should be comical."
I hooked it up and, as others have said, figuring this thing out is NOT straight forward, the instruction manual is weak to say the least, the good news is, as I found, there are many intrepid experimenters who, like me, bought it on a whim and did some trial and error which it'd seem 99% of them got the thing to work to their needs, just like me hence, I'm taking the time to write this review. What this lacks in coherent features or instructions it makes up for it in the end by eventually (boy I mean eventually) getting the job done, for that honestly I'm giving it a generous five stars, because it did what I wanted it do against all odds, just like the Phil Collins song. ("Just take a look at my car now, 'cause it's finally starting here.")", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "dsk", "review_title": "Reliable. I needed to start my emergency generator, and the battery was dead. I start the generator every month and run it for 1 hour to maintain the battery. This battery was only 7 months old. I was lucky. I had a battery for the sump pump in case of emergency, and I was able to use it.
Here it is the end of August 2026, and we've been experiencing thunderstorms daily. Last night the electricity went out. I've had the battery on the NOCO Genius 1 since January. I installed it and the generator started right up.
The battery has been on the charger for 7 months, so if there was a problem with the charger, I'd know by now. The charger is reliable and it protects the battery. Choose the right one by amperage of your battery.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Brian", "review_title": "Seems pretty good so far", "review_text": "I have two of these. They are not exactly the same model (I think one of them is an older version of this model). The older one, I have had in the garage for several years to keep the batteries in the cars up when they are not driven very often. Some people say these are not for car batteries and I won't argue with them but the one I have out there definitely keeps the battery in my 2001 Corolla charged. And in fact, we had an incident where someone left a dome light on in that car and drained the battery to the point to where there was absolutely no response from anything electrical in the car. We started the car with a jumper pack, pulled it in the garage and connected it to the Noco and let it do it's thing. That's been at least a year and that battery is still going strong in that car.

One of them had been sitting in the garage for several years due to the fact last time I tried to charge it, it wouldn't charge. The cable length is perfect and is versatile on all my different batteries. It ensures that when I look at it, the light is on I know it’s charging and when I disconnect and start my vehicles up or install the battery into one of the vehicles it works peace of mind it’s worth the price. The value for the money is way better than buying a new battery I have four of them and they’re all hooked up to cars and farm equipment. Definitely will not stop using this type of product. Highly recommend if you want to save money get this and not worry about your batteries.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "John Thomas Smith", "review_title": "Works with a REALLY low battery", "review_text": "My wife has a 1995 Mercedes SL320 that she did not drive all winter and well into the new year... when she opened the garage door and tried to start it the battery was dead, drained by MANY months of the old style mechanical clock running without the car being started so the battery could charge
My (brand name withheld) several year old 10 amp 'smart' charger would not work because the battery was too low to be detected
So, I looked for a different charger with a FORCE mode to get a dead battery to start charging... I connected this one at about 7PM at night (it never would go into force mode, since the battery had 'just enough' charge to be detected) and when I get in the car at 7AM the next morning the battery had enough of a charge for the dash lights to come on, but not enough to run the starter
The PDF I downloaded shows that this 1 amp charger will take 'about' 23 hours to charge a 30 AH battery... the battery in her SL320 is a 100 AH model, so I will let the charger run for another full day before I try to start the car again (or maybe 2 days to get the charger enough time to work)", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "W. Every time I need to back it out of the garage, the battery is dead.
I know that just sitting isn't good for batteries, not to mention this battery is several years old.
Now keep in mind, this is a large amp battery for a SUV, which was so dead, a turn of the key and I didn't even get lights on the dash. I stuck this little charger on it and it took a day and a half, but it charged completely. Ok, now I'm beginning to get a tad impressed.
I have two of those old type chargers, you know the ones that after a while you can hear the acid boiling inside the battery, and the battery is getting really hot... you know the chargers that tell you not to leave it on your battery for any extended period of time as this might (will) damage the battery (possibly even start a fire). Well... no more.
I'm a total convert now to using smart chargers, and this one seems especially good. I really hope I don't find some little something that breaks 6 months from now, cause I really like this charger! It seems very well designed and made and most of all, it works great.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Erich S. My one criticism is that there is no conventional instruction manual included. Instead, you scan a QR code and go online for the instructions. That worked fine for me, but I don’t think it’s a particularly good choice for a product like this. Other than that, my first experience with it has been very positive. Title: Levoit Air Purifier for Home Pets Bedroom Dorm Room, Smart & Voice Control
Category: Home & Kitchen,Heating, Cooling & Air Quality,Air Purifiers
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Lisa C", "review_title": "Affordable and effective for dust and allergens", "review_text": "We moved into an incredibly dusty townhouse, I have terrible allergies, and we discovered our neighbors are chain smokers. We now have 3 Levoit air purifiers in our home: Vital 100 (non-smart version), Core Mini and Vital 200S.
I initially bought the Vital 100 and put it in our bedroom because I have terrible allergies. It collected a ton of dust and helped a lot with the allergies. I thought I didn't need the smart version but in hindsight the availability of specialty filters and the remote control would be very helpful. It's relatively quiet although on high it's too noisy for me to sleep with. I absolutely love that you can turn the all the control lights off. We tried using this for the cigarette smell but it wasn't very effective except when the smell was very light. It did completely abolish cooking smells though. If I could go back in time I would have ordered the 100S instead but this one works fine.
The smoke smell from the neighbors comes into our house through the laundry room which is a very small room. I bought the Core Mini to try to combat it. The Core Mini doesn't really do much to get rid of smells and was definitely overwhelmed by the smoke so now we move it around the house now when the pollen level is high. It works ok for dust and allergens but the range isn't great; you need to be right next to it to notice a difference. On low and medium speed it's barely audible and high is relatively quiet but overall the fan isn't very powerful. The lights on this one automatically turn off after a few seconds making it bedroom friendly. If I could do it again, I would have skipped this one and bought one of the larger ones sooner.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "RAERAE", "review_title": "Best Purchase All Year", "review_text": "I simply cannot say ENOUGH good things about this product! After 2 weeks of use the air feels lighter, I no longer wake up with a stuffy nose or junk in my lungs and I bought the pet specific air filters that are an added bonus. I LOVE the lighting features and that you can sync the device to my phone and set up schedules so it's quiet at night. The controls are SUPER easy to use and fool proof.
Just don't forget to open the base when you get it and take the plastic packaging off around the air filter!!! I forgot to do this and wondered why there was no air flow coming out of the top till I Googled it. 😂😂😂", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Robert Blackorbay", "review_title": "great replacement for my bedroom", "review_text": "I use this in a room I use to have an Ionic air purifier, the old worked there was some dust near the unit, but the smell of Ozone was too much since i kept my door closed most of the day. the Levoit was a perfect replacement, no smell, lot less noise and my room felt refreshed when i open the door. I have the 330 model for over 2 years in the Livingroom and i happy with that one as well. the only down i don't like is the 300 can sense the air and adjust where the 200 can't, but you can program to go on or off multi times throughout the day, the night light is a nice touch for when it's in my sons room or i want to see enough light in a pitch black room. fits perfect in my bedroom, cleans the air, no dusty or ozone smell. very effective for the rom it is in.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Alimistar", "review_title": "Great small sized air purifier that does some heavy lifting", "review_text": "I got this air purifier for my bedroom as my sleep can be disturbed by air quality pretty easily. I was highly skeptical of this product at first as the price point to me indicated that it might be cheap in terms of quality of the product but so far it has been pretty impressive. On even the lowest setting, it has substantially improved the air quality not just in the bedroom but in the adjoining room so we're looking at space of about 200-300 square feet or so. I would say I can breathe easier at night with it and my comfort level while sleeping has increased a bit.
The air after it's been running for a bit smells and just seems fresher and I am considering getting a second one to see if it can handle a much larger area.
Noise is pretty low on it's lowest "normal" setting and the night mode feature drops the noise to almost silent, but not quite. At it's lowest setting, there is an odd whine, for lack of better words that can just barely be heard. This whine was an annoyance at first but you get used to and can ignore it. It still works well on the lowest setting to keep the room fresh so it's a good deal.
Setup was easy as can physically, however I cannot as yet speak to the application setup as I haven't gotten to that. I treat air purifiers as non-smart devices but I do plan to at least try to integrate it with Home Assistant and if that doesn't work I may try integration with Amazon Alexa. I'll update the review when that happens.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "easybreezy6", "review_title": "Skeptical About Used? This Changed My Mind", "review_text": "I chose the Amazon box option mainly so I could check whether the item shipped safely and arrived without damage to the outer packaging. The Amazon box itself arrived in good condition, but the Core 200S-P’s box was damaged, likely because it had not been handled carefully during a previous shipment.
Since I bought it in Used – Acceptable condition, I inspected the purifier carefully. I found no issues with the unit itself. It came with what appears to be a new filter, had no strange smell, and works perfectly, just like my other Core 300S-P, which I recently bought new.
I also bought a second unit in Used – Good condition. The only thing I noticed was a black scuff mark on the bottom of the purifier, as shown in the pictures, but it does not look like actual damage. The box for that one also appeared to have been damaged during a previous shipment. From my experience buying used items on Amazon, that seems fairly common, and it is probably one reason the price is lower when the manufacturer’s box is damaged.
I ran it for an hour on level 3, the highest fan speed and it seems to be working perfectly. Afterward, the room smelled cleaner and felt easier to breathe in. I also found no visual issues.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Jen", "review_title": "1000% RECOMMEND!", "review_text": "I bought this purifier because I really wanted one that I could turn on from my phone while laying in bed, since I am completely blind in the dark due to my vision impairment, and I don't necessarily have anywhere to place this type of electronic near my bed that was the major deal breaker for me. This air purifier is about the size of a PS5, but a little more convenient due to the cylinidrical shape of it. The app set up is easy and it allows you to auto order a new filter through the app via a scheduled set up. I have mine set up for every 6 months and you can tell the difference between the 2 filters after those 6 months.... the app also will tell you the life on your filter left and will tell you the air quality/ pollen count outside of your home. All the modes do exactly as they say and the sleep mode is ultra quiet which is nice. I've been using this air purifier for almost 2 years now and it is still working great. You can immidetly tell when you take it out of the box that it is a good high quality purifier and not a purifier where they say its high quality and after a week it stops working... My last purifier was lmof a lower quality and stopped working with-in a year, but also I paid $50 for that one and I didn't have a dog at that time.
It is so nice to have a higher quality purifier that works exactly as it says on the ads. The app also includes other Levoit electronics you can add to your account so you have all your Lwvoit products in one spot on your phone which I think is so mice and easy. The app is also really easy to use and to set up everything on, it looks and feels very professional and easy which I really enjoy. I love opening up my app and seeing all my Levoit electronics in one spot, ready to turn on or off, or to change any mode it's on to something different. You can aslo set up a schedule of when you would like your devices to turn on and off and what mode to use whenbit does.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "lej", "review_title": "My 1st Levoit is "Le Bon" - Good quality,, easy to use", "review_text": "Highly recommend it so far - have only used it the past week BUT it is during the worst air quality in the world time in Chicago from the Canadian and Minnesota wildfires. It really seems to be working, helping. Easy to put together - no actual assembly required. Nice and small, very quiet (sound free on sleep), and you should totally download the recommended app. I wasn't thinking I would, but so helpful and serves like a remote almost. Already recommended to 2 friends and another who bought it already. Good product so far!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "KW", "review_title": "Surprisingly effective — glad I stuck with it", "review_text": "This was my first time ever using an air purifier, so I was pretty skeptical even after reading all the good reviews. The first few days were honestly a little discouraging because my bedroom still smelled kind of funky. I live in an older house, and getting certain smells out of the rooms has been a big priority while I finish setting everything up.
But after about a week, the difference became really noticeable. Now it’s actually refreshing to walk into my room. I’m really glad I didn’t give up on it early.
I also share my bedroom with a Husky, and there’s no dog smell anymore — which is huge. The fan is pretty quiet, and even when I turn it up, the sound is kind of soothing. It actually reminds me of the ocean waves from my trip to Ormond, FL, which is a nice little bonus.
The filters are easy to insert and remove (I haven’t had to replace mine yet, but I tested it out just to see), and the whole unit feels simple and user‑friendly.
Overall, very happy with this purifier. It took a little time, but it absolutely did its job.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Hein?", "review_title": "Indispensable.", "review_text": "Je ne sais pas par où commencer, mais en tout cas, je suis super satisfait. L'appareil a un joli design et on sent la qualité. Sur l'écran tactile, il y a tout ce qu'il faut.
Ce que j'adore, c'est le fait qu'il soit connecté à l'application. Elle est vraiment super simple et complète sans en faire trop. On peut voir sur les photos qu'il est indiqué quand il faut changer le filtre (par exemple, il affiche 100 % quand il est neuf) ; on peut donc suivre son état d'usure au fur et à mesure.
En plus, juste en dessous, tout est prévu :
1. Il y a un lien « acheter le filtre »
2. Ce lien vous redirige directement sur Amazon
3. Le filtre coûte actuellement 25 €, ce qui n'est pas trop cher puisqu'il faut le changer tous les 3 à 6 mois
C'est vraiment bien pensé. La notice est en français, mais j'avoue qu'on n'en a pas vraiment besoin car tout est expliqué étape par étape dans l'application.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "barney", "review_title": "Fresh air.........", "review_text": "Our vet has this air purifier in each of their exam rooms, what a difference it makes. I bought one for the laundry room as we have a new puppy. You can sense the fresh air straight away. Great purchase.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Henry", "review_title": "I Looove it!!", "review_text": "Just love it and cools the room when active. Integrated with Alexa and so far it's been working really well.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "David O Neill", "review_title": "WARNING WARNING WARNING", "review_text": "I've made a complaint to amazon supoprt.
If you haven't noticed it like my this product is not European, its American and 110 volts.
No idea why they are listing it on European site without sufficient warning.
Better tittle might be
Levoit Vital 100 Air Purifiers (110 volt US)", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Isaac Olmedo", "review_title": "Excelente", "review_text": "El producto llegó a tiempo y en buen estado. Aunque el manual viene en inglés, es súper sencillo hacer el montaje y encenderlo. Tener la app en el celular hace más fácil controlarlo y pude conectarlo con Alexa sin ningún problema, además de que en la app te avisan el tiempo de vida que tiene el filtro, para poder monitorearlo y cambiarlo cuando sea necesario.
El purificador me ha funcionado muy bien, tiene 3 niveles, el más alto es el más ruidoso aunque no es molesto, muy parecido al ruido generado por un ventilador, el modo para dormir es una maravilla, prácticamente no se escucha nada y puedes programar a qué hora se apaga lo que me parece muy práctico.
Cuando llegó lo encendí en la recámara y una hora después ya notaba la diferencia en el aire, tengo alergias y sentía el aire más fresco para respirar y dormí muy a gusto sin estornudos ni tos. El filtro lo limpié con la aspiradora y fue muy sencillo, aunque no se elimina todo el polvo que se acumula, si se lleva gran parte lo que sin duda ayuda a que dure y filtre mejor por más tiempo.
Sí lo recomiendo, cumple bien su función y no considero que el precio sea excesivo.", "review_rating": ""}]

It’s soothing to me.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Shawn R.", "review_title": "A really great air purifier that has many key improvements/advantages over its competitors", "review_text": "I got this air purifier for a relative that has COPD. They already had an Alen T100 that they were pleased with. But, as is common in multiple industries where a core product requires a consumable, it's often not the condition of the core product but the availability of the required consumable that dictates when a product has to be replaced. While I've been able to find enough replacement air filters for that one air purifier, when the need arose for a 2nd air purifier for a second section of the house, instead of just getting a newer Alen, I opted to start the research process all over again and, this time, the clear winner was Coway And, as well as the Alen has done over the years, it didn't take long to see how much better the Coway model was by comparison. A first major difference is in the design and aesthetics. With several color variants and another model with a more classic look, it doesn't visually stand out as much as a typical tower air purifier does. It's more stylish and "elegant". Second, there are actual very practical functional reasons for those aesthetics. Instead of blowing air on people horizontally, it blows the air straight up so that nobody feels the air blowing. It's also significantly quieter so even set on medium speed it's quieter than the Alen at low speed. That's impressive given that this model is designed to handle a space 3X as much as the Alen was. But, it's due to the design of having the air come in from the sides and then exit out the top. It just provides a much more natural method of air circulation. And, also means it can be tucked along a wall and out of the way ... with the cord blocked from view if located directly at the power outlet. Another great feature that the Coway has that I haven't seen before is that you have 4 stage filtration .... with the initial pre-screen stage being a built-in filter that can be washed ... followed by the 1st charcoal filter to catch large objects like hair .... followed by a 2nd filter that have 4 replacement options and therefore can be customized based on what types of odors or particles a person needs filtered out ... and finally the HEPA filter that catches the smallest particles that make it past the other three. Not only is this like a coin-sorter process of filtering out different things at different people ... but this is why, unlike a lot of air purifiers, the main filters can last 1 year instead of just 6 months. The built-in filter is recommended to be cleaned once a month. The charcoal filter 6 months. The "environmental/smell" filter being replaced once a year. And, the HEPA filter being able to last even longer depending on environment. Where it actually gets better at filtering over time ... but then the tradeoff is air flow reduction. That's why the official recommendation is still once a year. And, best of all, the NYT wirecutter review I'd found says Coway has made continual improvements over the years to this product, which really shows. Many manufacturer's just seem intent on constantly reinventing the wheel and it seems Coway was instead focusing on perfecting what it already had. Very pleased with the results and the good deal we'd gotten on it. While we hope the Alen continues to do well for several more years, at least it's nice knowing that we already know what to replace it with whenever it become necessary.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "shark", "review_title": "Beyond Expectations", "review_text": "After being very impressed by the 400 in the main, open living/cooking/eating areas of the house, added a Mighty2 to the bedroom. Wife loves some white noise to go to sleep to...I'm not big on it but much prefer the Mighty2's Turbo noise to a box fan on low or medium settings.
Performance is fantastic. Noticeably fresher air and has worked wonders keeping dust/dander/dog hair from settling on surfaces in between dusting and vacuuming sessions. The LEVOIT Air Purifier Core Mini caught my attention because of its compact size and features. I picked up the white version, and I've been using it primarily on my office desk. Pros:", "review_rating": ""}]

Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "B. Fields", "review_title": "Very Glad I Bought this Cooker", "review_text": "Look, I'm just a basic guy. When I cook something, it has to be fairly simple but I also want it to taste good. Usually it doesn't. While I like to eat "gourmet," I don't have near the patience or interest to cook that way. I have made up a recipe I call a "beef stew chili." I throw in some bell peppers, onion, jalapeno, cayenne pepper, etc. - you get the idea - and then throw in a couple of pounds of beef stew meat. Usually this recipe comes out with rubbery meat, even it I cook it in a slow cooker. I've tried braising this and sauteing that, but it still comes out rubbery. When I made this recipe in the Yedi, the meat came out amazingly tender - a first for me - and I didn't have to do anything fancy to get it that way. Plus the whole thing tasted great. Another first. I have since tried a couple of other recipes and they came out surprisingly good. Honestly, I can't believe I made them. So, if you are a basic guy like me, you will really appreciate this product. I bought this particular unit on the strength of the customer reviews and find I agree with the 9 out of 10 customers who rate this product 5 stars. But I did note at the time I made the purchase that it didn't have much in the way of accessories. Now that I've found I truly like this cooker and seem to be using it all the time, I wrote off to the company asking if the various accessories made for the 6 quart Instant Pot would also work with my Yedi. The interesting and impressive thing was that I wrote my inquiry on a Sunday late afternoon and got a reply within an hour from Bobby Djavaheri, Vice-President, Yedi Houseware. This, my friends, is customer service when you have a C-level officer responding to a run of the mill user questions on a Sunday no less. Actually, I was a little shocked. (But happy since he told me that all of the Instant Pot 6 qt. accessories would, in fact, work on the Yedi, so actually we have plenty of accessories to choose from.)", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "RockGirl", "review_title": "Worth the Hype", "review_text": "How did I ever live without one of these? * Anything you cook in it is truly "set it & forget it". You simply can't open it up to stir or add ingredients... Once the lid is on and pressure is set, that's it! This is a major time saver because I don't have to be in the kitchen at all while the food cooks.
* I have approximately 1.5 zillion lbs of dried beans in my pantry. This makes cooking them super easy! I'm able to cook a whole pound at a time and have beans for a couple meals. I prefer dried beans because they're cheaper and can be cooked with as much or as little salt as you want, but my previous method involved me popping back in to check on the pot and making sure it wasn't foaming over. This is much easier. They don't even have to soak ahead of time. Rinse, add water, cook!
* It can cook frozen meat! I'm still testing the limits of this. I tried with frozen chicken breasts that were stuck together and the middles didn't quite get done. The accessories are awesome- I use the little silicone “gloves” all over the kitchen. I prefer this Yedi brand over my original InstaPot brand and it is used at least 5 times a week in my kitchen. It cuts down cook time a great deal, just be prepared for it to build pressure- this can take a while depending on what you’re cooking. I especially love it for making soups, stews, broths, rice (don’t forget to oil the pot), beans, “boiled” eggs, veggies (season the water at the bottom and make sure the veggies are not touching any water or they get mushy), baked potatoes, the list goes on and on!! You can even precook veggies and ground meats with the sauté and then add your other ingredients and set it to go instead of browning meat or softening veggies on the stove. Its good for meats (even from frozen), just make sure you take advantage of the sauté feature to sear it for max flavor. Do not put anything with skin in it- it gets super gross. And you can always throw the meat in the oven for a quick 5 min broil to round out the sear/ color after it’s done in the instant pot. There are ENDLESS recipes online to keep things interesting.
