The app recipes are helpful, and having so many cooking functions in one appliance saves both time and counter space.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "RoseAnn", "review_title": "I like that the app has a "Timed Venting" option", "review_text": "Updated 12/29/24 - My Instant Pot timed venting wish has finally come true, so I just changed my rating to five stars. They added a new app option when timed venting is selected, so now you can choose the amount of time you want to vent the pot. It takes the guessing game out of using the timed venting feature. It's the addition I have been hoping for ever since they added timed venting to the app.
Updated 9/27/24: They just added a new notification feature to the app and I really like it. You get a push status notification when the pressure cooker starts preheating, then moves to the cooking cycle, then goes into venting mode and when it completes the venting cycle. It's particularly helpful to get notified when it goes into the venting process in case you want to precisely time the venting based on what you are cooking. It's a helpful enhancement.
Original review - I have an older model 6 QT Instant Pot Pro and I wanted this new one for its ability to connect to wifi, so I can use the app to control it. I especially like that the app has an extra venting option that is not available on the panel of the Instant Pot itself. It's a "Timed" option (see photo) that I actually discovered by accident when I was programming a cooking cycle. It's not explained anywhere in the documentation or even in the app, but it's very helpful when doing grains where I want it to natural release for a few minutes and then quickly finish the release without manual intervention. This is where the "Timed" option comes in. It seems to kick in about five to seven minutes after natural release starts. It varies, maybe based on how full the pot is, but since there's no documentation, it's just a guess on my part. It works great because I can be anywhere in the house and not have to rush to my kitchen to manually change the venting to quick release. I really love being able to monitor the progress from my iPhone and see when it has finished whatever cycle I've chosen.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "GeauxBucks!", "review_title": "Techies like us, love having Bluetooth accessibility! Great InstantPot!", "review_text": "Our original InstantPot just "bit the dust." We LOVED having it and it produced many, many wonderful memories meals for us.
While we mourned the passing of our "Old Faithful" InstantPot, I decided to start researching other electric pressure cookers and again, we came back to InstantPot and wanted to see what options they had. After reading all of the reviews and articles on this particular model, I told my wife 'PLEASE, PLEASE get me this one for Christmas!" She said, you can go ahead and order it but you're not allowed to open it until Christmas! Like anyone, I said YES!!!!
I opened it and then downloaded the app being that it is Bluetooth compatible. I cannot tell you enough, what a pleasant surprise it was, to see just how easy it was to set up and connect via our home WiFi. I can now use the app to set the time, the release time, etc. It's amazingly friendly to use and works great. One thing I will tell you is that if you, like me, use the Saute' mode, to first brown meat, you can NOT start hte InstantPot in this mode via the app. You must physically hit the start button in order to have the Saute' mode come on. Yes, you can set it up in the app but cannot physically start the InstantPot in this particular mode. I know I"m repating myself but I want to make sure that everyone understands this. To me, it's a safety feature and I can appreciate why it's done this way. The last thing you want to do is to accidently have your InstantPot start in this mode while you're away or remote.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "St8kout", "review_title": "So far it's pretty great", "review_text": "There are a ton of youtube videos, showing you not only how to use it but how to make one pot dinners.
It's easy to use, wifi is easy to set up which afterwards connects whether you are using the app or not, to show remaining cooking time. I only have basic cooking skills, so I prefer to watch the youtube videos for recipes than the app for now.
Food prep always takes the longest, but once you have everything ready, put the food in, close the lid, set the time and wait for it to finish.
When you set a time according to a recipe, that is the actual Pressure Cooking time. The unit has to preheat before Pressure Cooking time begins, and that's several minutes depending on the model. Then the unit has to vent the pressure (choice of Natural, Pulse, or Quick Vent.) Be careful with Quick Vent as it may make some meats tougher than if you simply waited for the Natural vent process.
If you enable push notifications, it will tell you when preheating has ended and cooking has begun, and of course when cooking has ended and venting has begun (you'll likely hear the venting process from the next room.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "sgopal2", "review_title": "Better Features than Older Models - But Several Important Differences", "review_text": "This is my second instant pot. My IP Ultra model recently died so I had to upgrade. Here are several important differences from previous models:
1) The inner pot has two hand holders - this is great because the previous models would swirl around when stirring. This new version prevents that from happening.
2) The cord is not removable - not a huge deal, but wondering why they would make this change. The cord is located in the back left corner. So plugging into an outlet on the back right made for a strange bend in the cord. Wondering why they can't simply place the cord in the back middle. Not a deal breaker for me, but you should be aware of it.
3) Steam valve: this works a bit differently than other models. No way to manually vent or release steam. It has to be done through the control panel. It is possible to change the setting mid-stream, but there is a delay of a few seconds once you input on the control panel.
4) Older IP accessories may not work - I used to do Pot-in-Pot cooking with a 2 level PIP on top of a trivet. This worked fine in my Instant Pot Ultra. But the first time I tried it in my IP Pro Plus, the pin got stuck, and the lid locked closed. I couldn't open it because the pin needed room to clear. I managed to figure a way out to open it by turning the pot upside down. But this new IP seems to have a slightly lower clearance. So you'll have to use a shorter trivet, or a shorter PIP. Otherwise your lid may get stuck in locked mode.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amazon Customer", "review_title": "Connectivity problems at first but resolved now and great product", "review_text": "What’s the point of having this fancy model if I can’t download and use the app with it?! Apparently I’m not the only one. There appears to be an issue with connectivity and iPhone 15ProMax. I was planning on cooking up a storm over the weekend but will have to wait until next week to speak with customer service. I will revise my review if the issue gets resolved. If not, this is sadly being returned. Lots of nice upgrade features from my very old instant pot so I will be sad if I have to return it.
Note: I tried to get app on my husband’s different model iPhone. FYI I live in NY, hardly an out of the way place. Photo below shows what I received when I scanned QR code in user manual to get the app.
Update: Figured I'd try one more time today before contacting customer service. IT ALL WORKED FINE! I have absolutely no idea what the problem was before but apparently it's fixed. I changed my rating from 1 star to 5. I'm sitting at my computer monitoring the progress of my steel cut oats as I write this. App is amazing!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Jace", "review_title": "USED item sold as NEW", "review_text": "UPDATE: Received replacement and it's the WRONG (older model with fewer features) in the box! Update 2: The replacement pot was in the correct box, but had a different Instant Pot in it. The ouside of the box very clearly says Instant Pot, and the device inside also is an instant pot, the same model as our old one but not the upgraded version we bought.
Contacted Instant Pot directly to see what can be done about getting the WRONG item in the RIGHT box.
Their incredibly lame and disappointing response is "We don't sell that"
I can find the exact same model we ordered on their website. The app works amazing with it it cans my beans beautifully genuinely love this Instant Pot! I think my friends are getting tired of hearing me. Talk about Instant Pot cooking. I’m keeping my other Instant Pot too so I can have two on hand :-)", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Elena", "review_title": "Práctica y rapidísima", "review_text": "La mejor de todas . Mucho más rápida que las anteriores . Presuriza se volada .", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Nell", "review_title": "La más fácil de usar", "review_text": "Esta es la 5ta IP que compro, las otras dos que actualmente uso son el modelo normal Pro de 8qt y la Pro que incluye tapa Airfry.
A pesar de que las 3 sean “Pro”, está sería mi opción si sólo tuviera 1, en verdad se siente superior a las otras. Desde lo estético de la pantalla hasta los niveles de personalización de los programas y que todo esto lo puedes controlar desde la App.
Lo único es que es de 6qt. que en mi caso fue por lo que al final me decidí a adquirirla (las otras 2 que uso son 8qt). Si la capacidad no es problema, 100% recomiendo este modelo por sobre todos los demás.
Si buscas tu primera IP, agrego que de todas las que he tenido, es la más fácil de utilizar.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Jim P", "review_title": "Pleasantly Surprised after I decided to Ignore a negative review.", "review_text": "Instant Pot Pro Plus Exceeds Expectations:

Title: Instant Pot Duo Crisp 6 Qt 11-in-1 Air Fryer + Pressure Cooker, Steel
Description: 11 Cooking Functions: Air fry, roast, bake, dehydrate, pressure cook, slow cook, sauté, steam, sterilize, warm, or cook rice with ease.
Category: Home & Kitchen,Kitchen & Dining,Small Appliances,Electric Pressure Cookers
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "College Mom", "review_title": "Remarkable multi-function pot!", "review_text": "I was wary of the air fryer feature, but this did really well. It has two layers, so I was able to cook 2 servings of nuggets and tater tots. Just be aware that you can't really remove the top layer easily to flip the bottom layer. This version has the pressure cook, but also slow cook and even sous vide. It is great for a dorm or small apartment. I just wish it had an all-in-one lid for storage purposes, but I can see how the two different lids are necessary.
Like my previous instant pots, the quality of materials and ease of use seem quite good. I would buy again.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Bunny Buddy", "review_title": "Worth the upgrade from a 6qt Duo", "review_text": "This was purchased as an upgrade from the 6qt Duo model. TOTALLY worth it and I've only used a single mode on each lid (Pressure Cook and Air Fry) so far. I didn't use other modes on the 6qt either including the pre-programmed settings. This is pretty much apples to apples comparison. Overall a complete win and would recommend it to others.
Benefits:
1. Handles on the inner pot. This keeps the pot from spinning during saute mode and makes it easier and safer to remove the pot when it's full of food. I can do this even after a wrist injury.
2. Flat bottom on the pot. Makes any added oils spread evenly instead of running to the edge and enables #3 below.
3. Pot is stove-top safe. Even more versatility! I tried this today and the handles did get a bit too warm to touch from the gas heat flowing up the sides of the pot, but it enabled me to quickly control the temperature and still pressure cook the results in the same pot.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "M.", "review_title": "Instant Pot is ofc awesome, with the air fryer lid is even better!", "review_text": "This was a replacement for an IP which was damaged. I decided, even though I have another air fryer/toaster oven combo, to upgrade to this because I LOVE hot wings and they always make a huge mess in my other AF. This unit with its air fryer component keeps the mess contained and does a great job of getting the wings nice and crispy with no fat ridges on it and has really upped my wings to another level. It's not big enough to do bacon or a bunch of other things but specifically for those of us who LOVE hot wings, it is my new go to. Easy to clean too which my other AF is not.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "At Our Home We Think", "review_title": "What was I thinking?!", "review_text": "What was I thinking, taking so long to get this!!?
Our first meal we (me and my husband) prepared in our Instant Pot was a beef
pot roast with carrots and potatoes. Prep time was a whole 15 minutes. That
was just to get the veggies ready. Then we seared the pot roast in the Instant
Pot. Super easy! The searing isn't something everyone does, so that's a good
part of the prep time. Then the cook time was 40 minutes. That's it!! Dinner time!
I will say, you don't smell the food cooking. That may be a plus or a minus, depending
on how you're wired. I have fibromyalgia. Smells of foods cooking are NOT my friend.
So not smelling the food until right before eating was a real blessing for me! Now, to
the roast. It was so tender, we were able to cut it with a fork, and it was incredibly juicy!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Mark Hastings", "review_title": "Glad I bought it.", "review_text": "I decided to cheap out and bought one of these from the Amazon Warehouse. There are pros and cons to this which I will discuss at the bottom of this review.
This is a great piece of cookware, that is capable of many cooking techniques. I am happy with my purchase and would buy it again. It is relatively easy to program but you have to remember to press the Start button. (Something I forgot to do a few times.)
Saute - seems a little slow to get up to full temperature compared to stove top cooking, but it get there. The indicator is helpful to give you some idea of the current temp.
Pressure - works well. Lid is easy to place. One feature that seems small, but I REALLY love is the little "lid" on the top that you can remove to open a spot to place ice. This feature is wonderful as it allows you to quickly cool the pressure cooker and eliminate the need to do a pressure release and blow steam all over your kitchen. In practice, I have found that a handful if ice will drop the pressure in under 3 minutes.
Air Fry - this is a really nice feature to "finish" roasts. Pretty much a must have feature. It falls a little short in browning french fries, as you have to open the lid and shake the air fry basket to ensure even cooking. However, this is also true of most air fryers unless they have a tumble basket.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Michael R Herl", "review_title": "Good All Purpose Multi Functional cooker", "review_text": "Had to replace my all in One Ninja Pressure and Air Fryer combo unit. Like the simplicity of both Pressure and Air Fry Lids. Internal size holds 1/2 chicken and Rack of RIbs with ease. Used Pressure cooker and great sealing and quiet. Only issue is quick release is metal so need something to push it down., use wooden spoon. Appearance is nice in its metallic modern look", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Katie", "review_title": "So far so good!", "review_text": "I love my old instant pot, so when I was looking for a new one and saw that the version with the air fryer lid I was sold (after reading some reviews to make sure it wasn't terrible lol). I've been wanting an air fryer but couldn't justify another appliance when I wasn't sure I would use it that often.
I like the display, although I miss being able to hit the pressure cook button (or whatever setting you're using) to switch between three saved cook times and adjust from there, since pressure cooking times vary wildly. I do find adjusting the settings to be easier to figure out and more intuitive than the old "duo" version that I had, although setting the time from 5 minutes to 90 minutes by spinning the little dial is annoying.
The air fryer works fine- I can't compare it to a stand-alone model since I've never used one, but I made asparagus on the bottom rack and halibut on the top rack made with an egg wash, then a seasoned flour and Parmesan coating and both came out great. Nice and crispy compared to what I would have gotten in the oven.
I can also see myself using the sous vide option occasionally. I sous vide very infrequently by heating water to temp, then putting the pan in the oven on the lowest temp and monitoring the digital thermometer I use. Without a circulator, I expect the sous vide function is probably about the same level of effectiveness and accuracy, but easier. Maybe I'll do it more often now. If nothing else, I can use it to pasteurize eggs more easily for Caesar dressing and tiramisu.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Evelyn Rosario", "review_title": "Instant Pot Duo Crisp 11-in-1 Air Fryer and Electric Pressure Cooker Combo", "review_text": "The product is easy to use and supports hands-off food preparation, so users do not need to monitor it while cooking.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Kory V", "review_title": "Lots of use and always reliable.", "review_text": "Amazing kitchen appliance.
Takes up quite a bit of space but I use it so much it just has a home on the counter.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Ali Hil", "review_title": "Está excelente la olla, súper práctica.", "review_text": "Me encantó! Súper práctica, fácil de usar.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Rose", "review_title": "Panela de excelência!", "review_text": "A panela é simplesmente maravilhosa.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "SugyRocks", "review_title": "Tienes que tener una Instant Pot", "review_text": "La mejor inversión que puedes hacer. Me encanta hace de todo y súper rápido 💜", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "adele", "review_title": "Better than expected", "review_text": "Well, I don’t have much to say. I was scared because people were sharing burned cable, in other cases the product were arriving damaged. I realized that you have to take the risk, otherwise you will based your purchases by other people experience. With that been said.. Here everything arrived in perfect shape. Product works as it should be. Easy to use, rice cooks really fast (7 minutes in high pressure is the way I like it lol). I made this toast in the picture with egg and bacon on air fryer lid, awesome. The compartment for air fry is smaller than I thought but it works fine for us. And for the budget that we had, I think it was a good purchase. I don’t have nothing to complain about the pressure lid mode, everything turns on delicious food, for those who like cooked beans in Brazilian style it’s a must have. I’m very satisfied!", "review_rating": ""}]

Title: Oral-B iO Series 3 Limited Deep Clean Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush for Adults, Black, 3 Modes, Smart Pressure Sensor, Plaque Removal and Gum Care, 2 Replacement Brush Heads, Travel Case
Category: Health & Household,Oral Care,Toothbrushes & Accessories,Powered Toothbrushes & Accessories,Powered Toothbrushes,Rotating
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Dani", "review_title": "I love this toothbrush!", "review_text": "I always forget to write reviews after I buy stuff on Amazon. I should try to do it more because it is helpful when you find a review that is real.
So, I bought this toothbrush to replace another brand that I bought about a year and a half ago. The old toothbrush just wasn't doing a good job at cleaning my teeth. I have always had problems with cavities and plaque build-up. The only sure-fire way of getting all of the plaque for me was to use Plax prior to brushing. Still, I find myself in the dentist's office every six months with a hygienist jack-hammering my mouth with water pick to get my teeth clean. It's embarrassing and it makes me feel anxious about my gum health. I saw the Oral-B iO Series 3 here on Amazon and it was discounted. According to Oral-B it is really good at getting rid of plaque. I took the manufacturer at their word, and bought it. Holy crap, ya'll! This thing is amazing!
The iO3 has a round brush head similar to the polishing tool your dental hygienist uses. I've used cheaper Oral-B electric toothbrushes that also have round heads, but they weren't as robust as the brush head on the iO3. The bristles aren't hard, but they are dense and arranged in a way that they can hug your teeth while brushing. You can get that brush on every surface of each tooth (except directly between the teeth, of course). The motorized handle has a pressure sensor that changes color based on how hard or soft you are pressing. If you get it just right, it lights up green.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Alexander", "review_title": "A Nice Upgrade From My Oral-B Pro 100", "review_text": "I recently upgraded from my old Oral-B Pro 100 to the Oral-B iO Series 3, and I can definitely tell the difference. The brushing experience feels much smoother and quieter, and my teeth feel noticeably cleaner after each use.
One of my favorite improvements is the pressure sensor. It helps me avoid brushing too hard, which is something my old toothbrush didn't have. I also like the different cleaning modes they're simple to switch between and let me choose what feels best.
The brush head glides comfortably over my teeth, and the handle feels solid and well-made. Battery life has also been great so far, lasting several days before needing a recharge.
If you're still using an older Oral-B model like the Pro 100 and have been thinking about upgrading, I think the iO Series 3 is well worth it. It feels like a much more refined brushing experience, and I'm really happy with the purchase.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Firecapt45", "review_title": "Very nice looking, powerful and inexpensive. A great purchase!!", "review_text": "What a bargain!! This is replacing our old power toothbrush and upgrading to something much better. The cleaning modes are delightful, and the recharge time is efficient. Keeping the brush assembly in the holder and protected from the elements with the plastic case is such a great idea. The quality of this Oral-B toothbrush is second to none, as expected. The power and vibration of the brush is something we'll have to get used to, but that's a given considering our old one is well over 10 years old. 2 thumbs up on this product.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Elijah", "review_title": "Its a good toothbrush would recommend if your in the market", "review_text": "I’ve been using the Oral-B iO Series 3 for a few weeks now, and the difference compared to a standard electric or manual toothbrush is night and day. It leaves your teeth feeling amazingly smooth, like you just stepped out of a dental cleaning.
What makes it great:
Unreal Cleaning Power: The round micro-vibrating brush head gets into every spot with zero effort. My teeth have never felt cleaner or fresher.
Smart Pressure Sensor: This is probably the best feature. The light indicator shows green when you're using the right amount of pressure, red if you're pressing too hard, and white if you're too soft. It takes all the guesswork out of brushing and protects your gums.
Built-in Timer & Modes: The built-in 2-minute timer pulses every 30 seconds to let you know when to switch quadrants, making it super easy to ensure a complete clean every single time.
Solid Battery Life: Holds a charge really well for daily morning and night use, and the charging base takes up very little counter space.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Alireza", "review_title": "A noticeable upgrade from the Pro 1000!", "review_text": "I previously owned the Oral-B Pro 1000, and while it did a good job cleaning my teeth, this model is definitely an upgrade.
The pressure sensor is one of my favorite features. When I press too hard, the light changes color, making it easy to know when to ease up. It's a simple feature, but very useful.
It's also noticeably quieter and smoother than the Pro 1000, and the battery life is much better. Overall, brushing just feels more comfortable and enjoyable with this model.
I'm very happy with this upgrade and would definitely recommend it.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Kindle Customer", "review_title": "Best toothbrush I've ever owned", "review_text": "This is by far the best toothbrush I have ever used! The dentist told me several years ago to buy an electric toothbrush so I bought the cheap oral B ones from walmart and forced myself to use that several times a week. Thinking that was better then just using my regular manual one. My husband bought this in black about a month ago and liked it and it was on sale so I decided to jump and get it as well. I've been using it for a week now and my mouth still feels as clean as it did the day I came home from the dentist with a cleaning. It was a little strong on the vibrations at first but after the week of using it consistently it no longer bothers me. Its not loud at all and I love the 30 second interval vibrations it gives you so you know to move on to the next quadrant in your mouth. Over all the best thing I've bought all year. Would recommend it to everyone.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Deborah Ostien", "review_title": "Clean teeth are a must!", "review_text": "Really like this toothbrush. [{"reviewer_name": "Amazon Customer", "review_title": "Excellent Brand", "review_text": "I have been using this COSLUS electric toothbrush for theee months now and I’m genuinely impressed with what you get for the price. Best of all when you register the product you get a two-year warranty.
First off, the cleaning performance is solid. It has a strong sonic vibration that leaves my teeth feeling smooth and clean, comparable to other higher end electric toothbrushes I have purchased in the past. It’s noticeably more effective than manual brushing, especially around the gumline.
The battery life is another BIG win. I only charged it every 3-4 weeks. For travel or everyday use, that’s really convenient.
It also comes with multiple brushing modes, which is nice to have depending on whether you want a deeper clean or something more gentle for sensitive gums. The build feels lightweight but not cheap and it’s easy to hold even when wet.
The included 6 brush heads are a good bonus and they seem easy enough to replace when needed. Charging is simple with the included base and everything feels straightforward with no complicated setup or app required.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Aye!", "review_title": "First impressions matter—and COSLUS (BLACK) delivers!", "review_text": "This sonic toothbrush arrived in a sleek, well-designed travel case that immediately stood out. The case holds two brush heads (one for current use and one individually wrapped spare), and what really impressed me is the built-in ventilation. If you’re someone who brushes in the shower (🙋🏽‍♀️), this detail is huge. Bonus: the toothbrush itself is fully waterproof, so no concerns there.
The toothbrush is lightweight, slim, and comfortable to hold, making it feel more premium than bulkier electric brushes I’ve used. It features a 2-minute smart timer with 30-second quadrant pauses, which helps ensure even cleaning throughout the mouth. One feature I genuinely appreciate: if you stop mid-cycle—say, to sign for a delivery—the brush resumes exactly where you left off when you turn it back on. That level of thoughtful design doesn’t go unnoticed.
There are 5 distinct cleaning modes, and with each mode change there is a noticeable change in brushing pattern, particularly through the blue bristles and angled top bristles. The toothbrush overall is well designed and aligns comfortably with both teeth and gums, providing a thorough yet gentle clean. The brush head shape feels intentional, not generic.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Kayak Man", "review_title": "Excellent Product", "review_text": "It is an amazing bargain. I have been using the product for only several weeks, but so far it runs as well as my very expenive electric toothbrush. Being that it comes with extra brushes it is an excellent price point for what, so far, is an excellent product.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Osekou", "review_title": "A true Sonicare replacement but pulling the heads off takes serious grip strength", "review_text": "I finally refused to buy another $100 Philips Sonicare after my second one died exactly when the two-year warranty expired. I picked this COSLUS up at full price strictly because getting the handle a travel case and an 18-month supply of brush heads cost less than one pack of name-brand refills. I honestly expected a hollow rattling piece of cheap plastic. Instead the matte black handle has a solid weight to it and the motor delivers that intense high-pitched sonic hum that instantly foams up your toothpaste. After brushing twice a day for six weeks my teeth have that perfectly slick feeling you normally only get leaving the dentist chair.
The battery performance is what really convinced me to keep it. I left the wireless charger in the box and haven't plugged this thing in once since day one. I even took it on two weekend work trips without the cord and the motor hasn't dropped a fraction of its power. It does the standard 30-second stutter to tell you to switch quadrants which is great for mindless early morning brushing.
I am capping it at four stars for two very specific physical limitations. First the five cleaning modes change the rhythm of the brushing but you cannot adjust the actual intensity up or down. If the standard mode is too aggressive for your gums you just have to switch to the softer pulsating mode. Second the replacement heads lock onto the metal shaft so aggressively that taking them off requires an absurd amount of force. I actually had to wrap a hand towel around the brush head just to get enough grip to yank it off without snapping the plastic. If you have arthritis or hand mobility issues you should definitely skip this. But if you just want a reliable powerhouse of a toothbrush and don't mind wrestling with a piece of plastic every three months this is a massive steal.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Efrain Hernández", "review_title": "This toothbrush is amazing, you won't be disappointed.", "review_text": "This toothbrush is unbelievable, if you are a normal toothbrush user and never have tried one of this you will be very surprised. I bought it because I wanted to replace my old regular toothbrush and ended up getting this during a prime deal. First of all, price is incredible for what the toothbrush does. Also, I feel me teeth cleaner than ever before, at first I though it was going to be a regular toothbrush but no, I was very surprised, it vibrates and clean like nothing else and is super easy to use. Toothbrush itself looks very good quality and durable. I seriously recommend people try this and see what it does with their own eyes.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Patty Jackson", "review_title": "Worth the purchase!!!", "review_text": "This toothbrush works great and the replacement heads are very reasonable in price in comparison to the more expensive brand toothbrushes. I would definitely recommend buying this toothbrush if your looking for an affordable electric toothbrush that's just as good as the higher end brands.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "EK", "review_title": "Great toothbrush.", "review_text": "Never really liked electric toothbrushes. This one changed my mind. It’s lightweight. Easy to maneuver. Love the brush head. Nice and soft. Holds charge for a long time. Great brush options. It fits my not so big mouth. Compares to way more expensive toothbrushes. For that price I think it’s really worth buying it.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Paulo Torres", "review_title": "Electric toothbrush", "review_text": "The product is a very good toothbrush. It has different settings and it cleans my teeth very well. The only issue I have is that while brushing my teeth it has a hesitation. It stops mid brushing and re-starts and it keeps doing that while I brush my teeth. The battery life is great as described. It is a good product for the price.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Andrea Oropeza", "review_title": "10/10", "review_text": "Muy buena decisión, lo recomiendo", "review_rating": ""}]

One unexpected thing is that you can actually charge the new model on the older model's base. My spouse still uses the older model, and when we have extended travel together we take just one charger. Also, the other toothbrush had a pressure sensor which seemed like a good idea at the time, and maybe preferred by some. But the toothbrush head was so bulky that if I would get into a tight space, it would do its pause and notify thing. In the morning getting ready for work, nobody has time for all that adventure with a toothbrush lol! And was part of the reason I didn't bother to just find softer replacement heads. -Does it’s job.
-Would like it to have it had come with power plug adapter.
-May have been willing to pay a little more if came with sanitizer or extra brush heads, but oh well.

I only purchased this because I wanted a decent sonicare that didn’t cost too much after my smart bright electric toothbrush died. I had trouble deciding how to replace it, as I liked it a lot other than it was sooo difficult to remove the brush heads and that is how it broke. The smart bright brushes are great and my uv sanitizer charging stand it came with still works. I would have purchased a new brush itself if they actually sold one! Since they do not, I don’t think saving money on a smile bright is worth it, if you have to buy the whole thing every year or so because it will break eventually - the brush head part is plastic. Spending more for the Model 2100 or 4100 or other even more expensive ones DOES NOT IMPROVE DURABILITY.
My last 4 (over a 7-year period) all dies between 15-24 months. Always for the same reason; the rubber seal over the on/off button gets a hole in it, water gets in, and it kills the toothbrush OR the seal remains intact but the cheap switch within breaks (usually by not clicking anymore).
I have used Sonicare over 20-years. First and second toothbrushes lasted as long as I lived in those 2 houses, 10-years. Still for the buttons, and also for batteries that don't charge anymore.
The newer batteries they put in them now seem better, charges last longer . . . but because of inferior quality materials in the on/off switch and seal of the newer brushes I cannot tell you if the batteries will keep charging for 10-years, or even 5-years.

Here is my honest breakdown of how it performs:
⭐ Cleaning Performance & Power
Sonic Technology: Delivering solid vibration action, it drives fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline. It leaves your mouth feeling remarkably fresh—way cleaner than any standard manual brush. 
Single-Mode Simplicity: It features just one cleaning speed and one button. ", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Schmidel McGrödel, Esq.", "review_title": "Toothbrush is OK, but the rubber button ALWAYS gets destroyed in under two years.", "review_text": "I bought it again today. For a while you can push it harder and harder or maybe use a fingernail, but then it fails completely. Maybe water gets in through the hole in the rubber.
PHILIPS has had a decade to figure this out and fix it. Maybe they don't want to, because it leads to recurrent purchases.
Why do I buy it again and again? Because it works, and it's cheap, and it makes more sense to buy a $20 item once a year than an $80 item every three years. But terribly wasteful. Title: Oral-B Pro 1000 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush, Pink
Category: Health & Household,Oral Care,Toothbrushes & Accessories,Powered Toothbrushes & Accessories,Powered Toothbrushes,Rotating
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Katelyn", "review_title": "Crooked, Overcrowded, Yellow Teeth", "review_text": "Let me start this review by saying that when I was younger, much to my parent's dismay, I neglected to brush my teeth. I would brush them but not as often and as thoroughly as a child should. This was partly due to my very bad gag reflex and partly due to the fact that it felt painful (?). Anyway, I've had yellow teeth my whole life (I'm 29) because of it. I never got braces (thanks again gag reflex) but my parents tried everything to get me to have better oral hygiene and to have a more aesthetically pleasing smile. Now that I'm well into adulthood, my smile being so yellow, and also very crowded, was starting to bother me. I knew I had to give in and fix one or the other. (To be clear if you have crooked teeth don't feel like you have to change yourself just for society - after 29 years, I can say that I truly wanted to change the yellowness purely for myself). I've gotten healthier in almost all other aspects of my life. I decided to make the plunge and buy this in hopes it would help get my teeth cleaner and help reduce plaque buildup. Not just for aesthetics, but for actual oral hygiene.
So, I've used it twice a day for 3 days so far and my brother commented on how "white" my teeth look yesterday evening. That felt very good to hear, not gonna lie. I think this toothbrush is amazing for the price. I love how tiny the head of the brush is. It fits into my small, overcrowded mouth perfectly. I was worried that it would take forever to brush my teeth since I wasn't doing the work, the toothbrush was. However, it takes about 2 minutes and 30 seconds or 3 minutes if you're extra thorough. It allots 30 seconds to each section of your mouth, it will do a variation in the vibration to let you know when the 30 seconds is up and to move to the next portion of your mouth. It doesn't automatically shut off after 3 minutes (that I know of) if you want to go back and do another section of your mouth, which is nice. As for the pressure sensor on the toothbrush, mine does not work. It doesn't indicate any color or anything. It just appears to be a normal electric toothbrush. I may have gotten a "bad" toothbrush since it's not working, but to be honest, I truly just wanted something that would do a deep clean and this toothbrush does that. However, all the other reviews mention the sensor working so if that's something you're looking for, I would still highly recommend this toothbrush. I think mine might just be a dud in that department. The charging took several hours to be full on the first day. I keep it on the charger to ensure that it is always fully charged. If you don't have your charger with you and you need to rely on it without it, I'm told the battery lasts up to a week. Which, is very impressive for a $50 toothbrush. Amazon says that it has Bluetooth connectivity but I do not see any indication of that on the boxes or in the manual. My parents bought me an electric toothbrush when I was little, but I was too young to appreciate it. Now that I'm older, I think this is a great option for any person of any age. I do recommend it!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "CEH", "review_title": "Lasted 12 years before I had to buy it again! Superior clean without the hefty price.", "review_text": "After an incredible 12-year run with my first Oral-B Pro 1000, I finally bought it again!
The battery on my original brush finally bit the dust, and toward the end, it would only stay charged enough to get me through 24 hours of teeth brushing (if I was lucky) before dying. However, I loved the performance so much over the last decade that replacing it with the exact same model was an absolute no-brainer.
Here is why this brush is a classic:
Hygienist Approved: My dental hygienist once told me that it really doesn't matter how fancy or expensive an electric toothbrush is—any solid electric toothbrush is far superior to a manual brush. This model gives you that elite, professional clean without making you pay for unnecessary, over-hyped tech features.
The One Minor Con: If I have to name one downside, it is the noise. Even brand new out of the box, it does sound a bit like it might be powered by hamsters while it is working. But just because it doesn't sound whisper-quiet doesn't negate the fact that it is a remarkably solid, heavy-duty toothbrush.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amazon Customer", "review_title": "I love this toothbrush", "review_text": "I have used the Oral-B electric toothbrushes for many years. I’ve been told I have a small mouth and the small round head of this toothbrush is perfect for me. It makes every brushing like going to the hygienist—smooth clean teeth. It has a timer for a total of 2 minutes, with a change every 30 seconds to move you through the front and back of both sides of your mouth. I wouldn’t use any other toothbrush.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Kenenna Oyeka", "review_title": "Great everyday clean, but missing a couple of premium features", "review_text": "I’ve been using the Oral-B Pro 1000 for a few weeks now, and it does a fantastic job where it matters most: cleaning teeth. Coming from a manual toothbrush, the difference is night and day. My teeth feel incredibly smooth and "dentist-clean" after every use.
What I Like:
Powerful Cleaning: The oscillating CrossAction brush head really gets into the gaps and breaks up plaque effectively.
Pressure Sensor: The built-in pressure sensor is a great feature—it stops pulsing if you press too hard, protecting your gums.
2-Minute Timer: The handle pulses every 30 seconds to let you know when to switch quadrants, which makes it easy to stick to the recommended brushing time.
Room for Improvement:
Only One Mode: It only features a single, daily clean mode. If you have highly sensitive teeth, you might miss having a dedicated "sensitive" or lower-speed setting.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Lisa H", "review_title": "Great electric toothbrush but head replacement gets pricey!", "review_text": "Great, lightweight electric toothbrush with several different replacement heads to choose from. Lower upfront cost to purchase the toothbrush than other brands or models within the Oral-B family. Recharges fast and is easy to take on trips too. Only issue is with the price of replacement heads - that is where they get you. Just do your research as the brush heads need replacing every few months and it adds up.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Mattuccii", "review_title": "Don’t be frightened when your teeth feels clean for the first time!", "review_text": "Absolutely phenomenal. People weren’t lying when they said it feels like you just came from the dentist. I don’t know how it does it, but if you brush the same way you brush with a manual toothbrush, alongside the intense vibration, it feels like it removes 100% of plaque, especially the plaque that’s hard to get behind each tooth. Also, at first, the vibration may feel a little intense, but you’ll get used to it. But if it’s too strong, just press the button and it will go to a slower mode. I highly recommend the strongest mode for the most effectiveness. But hands down, this is the best toothbrush I’ve ever got in my life. I will say, because the brush is small, I usually apply the toothpaste on my finger and place it in my mouth manually, then brush. But that’s my personal preference. I just prefer more toothpaste. And it sits well on the charging pad. I honestly have no complaints.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Ejhersey", "review_title": "This is a bit pricy over time but it works well", "review_text": "Love this. Power runs about 5 uses for me. Good buy, only thing worth noting is that the new heads are like 15$ a pop which is expensive in the long haul.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amazon Customer", "review_title": "Excellent!", "review_text": "I love this brush and wish I had gotten one years ago! After learning from my hygienist how to use it correctly, this brush made brushing so much easier than a regular toothbrush and I can feel that the cleaning is so much more thorough. Love it. Well worth the ~$50 cost.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Jaber Alhussain", "review_title": "ممتاااااااااااااااز 👍", "review_text": "شكرا لكم على خدمتكم", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Zepherine", "review_title": "Great cleaning, versatile options for brush heads, charge lasts, but only 1 speed setting", "review_text": "One of my best purchases.
I used to clean my teeth with a manual toothbrush, thinking that if I spent enough time and diligence, it would provide the same level of cleaning as an electric toothbrush.
I was wrong.
After my very first cleaning with this device, I felt a level of clean teeth only experienced when I leave the dentist's office after a cleaning. And it wasn't just a subjective feeling. When I returned for my 6 month cleaning the next time, there was barely any tartar or plaque build up - all had been removed by this toothbrush. I also noticed that my level of bad breath and tonsil rocks declined significantly. Turns out a manual cleaning is nowhere near as good as this machine. I have purchased this toothbrush for familty and friends, telling them it has changed my life. I wish I had this device as a child!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Ali Khalid", "review_title": "ممتازه", "review_text": "جداً ممتازه", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Claudia", "review_title": "Limpieza profunda y guiada, excelente cepillo", "review_text": "He estado usando el Oral-B Pro 1000 CrossAction y me ha gustado mucho. La limpieza es más profunda que con un cepillo manual: ayuda a eliminar placa y cuidar las encías de manera más eficiente. El temporizador integrado facilita completar los dos minutos recomendados, guiando 30 segundos en cada cuadrante. Además, el cabezal redondo llega a zonas difíciles con mucha más facilidad que un cepillo convencional.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Diana", "review_title": "Excelente", "review_text": "Se siente la diferencia :)", "review_rating": ""}]

[{"reviewer_name": "Batman", "review_title": "wonderful", "review_text": "If you're looking to take your oral care routine to the next level, look no further than the **Oral-B iO Series 2 Rechargeable Electric Powered Toothbrush Starter Kit in Forest Green**. This toothbrush isn’t just an upgrade; it’s a complete transformation of how you approach your daily dental hygiene. From its stunning design to its incredible performance, the iO Series 2 is a game-changer that combines cutting-edge technology with a level of sophistication that makes brushing not only more effective but also enjoyable.
First, let's talk about the **design**. The **Forest Green color** is elegant and sleek, giving the toothbrush a premium, modern look that feels as luxurious as it performs. The ergonomic handle fits perfectly in your hand, offering a comfortable grip while you brush. It feels sturdy, well-made, and incredibly durable, which is exactly what you want in a product that you'll use daily.
But it’s the **technology** that sets this toothbrush apart. The **iO Series 2** utilizes advanced **smart pressure sensors** and **position detection** to guide your brushing technique in real-time, ensuring you’re brushing with the perfect amount of pressure and coverage. It’s like having a personal dentist in your bathroom, offering feedback to improve your brushing habits and ultimately deliver a more thorough clean. The **smart ring** lights up to alert you if you're brushing too hard or too softly, making it easy to avoid common mistakes and enhancing your technique with every use.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Ning Ding", "review_title": "Great toothbrush for everyday use", "review_text": "It’s easy to use, feels comfortable in my hand, and leaves my teeth feeling really clean and fresh. The design is simple and convenient, making it a great option for everyday use. The rechargeable battery is also very convenient.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Falarine", "review_title": "Great toothbrush", "review_text": "Works great, cleans teeth, has 3 speeds, and has a timer for all sections of your mouth, great toothbrush, own 2 in different colors 😀", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Tracy", "review_title": "Bad Quality.....Honest reviewer here............", "review_text": "My product came used the toothbrush itself was all covered in dirt the whole body of the toothbrush and then there were 3 pieces of toilet paper bunched up in the box now this is serious here sending people who buy brand new merchandise stuff like this and it has actually been happening to me frequently I used to see reviews about it and thought maybe they weren't true but now I'm learning that this is actually happening so without a doubt I'm telling you to buy this toothbrush somewhere else!!!! We were upgrading from a spinbrush so this was expensive for us for the toothbrush and especially the replacement heads it's a nice upgrade charging it with a plug instead of batteries like before and having options for the speed on the toothbrush and also the timer for brushing your teeth for 2 minutes and it's nice you get 2 different toothbrush heads to see which you prefer for your own personal preferences but getting a used toothbrush just grosses me out and it's wrong I purchased a new one I was so excited about getting a better and more advanced toothbrush but so disappointed once I received it", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "SouthernWriter", "review_title": "Upgrade - worth the expense, quieter", "review_text": "Was skeptical if I'd like this any more than the cheaper Oral-B 1000, but it has exceeded expectations. It's quieter and gentler on the lowest setting. My only skepticism remaining is around the brush head, which is recessed in the middle. I am not sure on how thorough a job that shape does, as it feels like only the edges touch my teeth. However, I can replace with a different style head when replacement is due. Has good battery life so far. Would recommend, it is worth the money for this upgrade.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Phoebe", "review_title": "Newer heads than I was used to", "review_text": "Nice and quiet. I like having 3 speeds. I don’t need a timer, but I do want to get alerts if I use too much pressure, which it does.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Mary", "review_title": "A simple but highly effective electric toothbrush", "review_text": "This toothbrush functions excellently. I don't need anything fancier - it has three different speed/pressure modes and recharges on it's base. I have a bar covering my lower teeth that is hard to clean, but this brush and it's heads do it well. This is my first electric toothbrush and I will be sticking with it as long as I can.
ONLY con is that grime buildup from the brushing process can build up in both the head and the stem of the brush unit. To keep them both clean, I remove the head, rinse both parts and tap them a few times on the counter to get the debris out. I let them both dry separately, and just reconnect it when I'm ready to use it again. It may seem tedious, but it keeps everything clean in the long run.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Carol", "review_title": "Does not keep a charge", "review_text": "I like the toothbrush but even though I charged it the appropriate time…like 2 days! After using it a couple days the red light comes on indicating it needs to be charged. I am returning for the same model and hope for better luck", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "mojerson", "review_title": "dscrizione incompleta", "review_text": "oggetto arrivato, ha spina inglese-americana non indicato nella descrizione. serve un adattatore (non incluso) o richiede modifica. impossibile contattare venditore", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Chris M", "review_title": "Termina siendo un cepillo manual", "review_text": "No lo compres!! Es tirar tu dinero a la basura, deja de funcionar de pronto, el cargador no carga, el motor deja de funcionar… y deja de funcionar cuando ya no puedes devolverlo, y la garantía un tema! BUSCA OTRA OPCIÓN", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Phil", "review_title": "Very Good Toothbrush", "review_text": "Excellent motor and good heads give a professional feeling cleaning each time. I wouldn't worry about the mold issues others mentioned, imagine they must life in especially damp or humid regions. Only complaint is the hard slippery plastic the wand is made from. It could use some rubber grips, very easy to drop, particularly when wet. Still, a massive improvement over my previous oral b b400.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amazon Customer", "review_title": "Not as good as I had hoped - updated", "review_text": "Not bad but not as good as Philips Sonicare. Had a Sonicare diamond but it has died after years of use. Read some good reviews of Oral-B but it's not as impressive as the reviews say. Doesn't clean my teeth as well as Sonicare.
UPDATE: I have changed my mind on this. I actually think this is better than Sonicated. I have changed the way I brush to suit this toothbrush and I have really ended up liking it. Changing to a 5 star. Would buy again.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Michael J Tucker", "review_title": "Works good", "review_text": "Works nice", "review_rating": ""}]

While it has several issues I could overlook, one major problem makes it unusable for me. The vibration of this brush feels “off” in a way that makes me dizzy and gives me a headache every time I use it,
and I’m not someone who normally gets headaches. I actually dread brushing my teeth with it, and at this point I’ll probably just accept the $60 loss and purchase something else.
The strange part is that the brush isn’t loud and the vibration doesn’t feel particularly strong, yet something about the way it operates gives me headaches even on the lowest setting.

I do this because to clean it after each use as directed takes a little time. Then you're supposed to balance the brush facing up and the handle facing down until dry. (I set them on a face cloth and lean them against an adjacent cabinet). So, the only time I use the stand is when it needs charging. With all of that said, I would still recommend it. As far as the tooth brush goes my wife uses it and she says she likes it which she has had a lot of electric tooth brushed so if she likes it then it must be good for her.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Ron's Raves & Roasts", "review_title": "Hygienist Approved Clean That’ll Make You Smile Wider", "review_text": "TL;DR: The Oral-B iO Series 2 turned my semi-okay brushing routine into something my dental hygienist actually high-fived me for. ________________________________________
What I Love
Feature Real World Impact
Automatic Pressure Sensor lights up red and slows the head if I press too hard, so my gums are finally spared my “scrub like a sidewalk” technique.
3 Modes (Super Sensitive, Gentle, Daily Clean) I start on Super Sensitive first thing in the morning, switch to Daily Clean after coffee—versatility without overthinking it.
2 Minute Timer with 30 Second Pulses Reminds me to hit every quadrant. I haven’t updated my electric toothbrush in many years. I had an older model of the same brand, and it just seemed like the motor/batter had gotten weak and it wasn’t functioning that well anymore.
I was definitely correct because this new Philips Sonicare packs much more of a punch compared to my old one. It was almost a little too much at first but I just needed a couple of days to adjust and now it’s great. I’ve noticed my teeth feel incredibly smooth all day long, like they do immediately after I go for a cleaning at the dentist. I got this on a prime day sale so it is absolutely worth the money, however having used it now I would have been happy paying full price for the update in quality compared to my old brush. After using it consistently, I’ve noticed a significant improvement in my gum health. My gums no longer bleed when I brush, which has been a wonderful and encouraging change.
The toothbrush leaves my teeth feeling much cleaner than a manual toothbrush, and I appreciate the built-in timer that helps me brush for the recommended amount of time. The different cleaning modes are easy to use, and the battery life has been excellent between charges.
As a retired pharmacist, I understand how important good oral hygiene is to overall health. Investing in a quality electric toothbrush has been well worth it, and seeing healthier gums has been the biggest benefit for me.
I would highly recommend the Philips Sonicare to anyone looking to improve their oral health, especially if they’re experiencing sensitive or bleeding gums. I have never been so impressed by a toothbrush, and did not realize there would be such a difference compared to my older simple version. It is powerful, but soft on the gums, so my teeth feel like they're getting scrubbed, yet there is no irritation or pressure on the gums. It has different speeds, including one for gum health. Weird to be going on so much over a toothbrush, but what a difference. It shows the battery level and has a light that lets you know when you are brushing too hard, which is not good for your teeth and gums. I really love that it has an automatic timer and lets you know when to move on to the next section of teeth so every tooth is thoroughly clean. I actually look forward to brushing my teeth now. Out of the box, you can tell this is a top tier, premium product with a lot of thought put into the engineering and design.
The matte black finish looks sleek on the bathroom counter, but more importantly, the build quality feels incredibly solid. The handle has a nice weight to it, offering a comfortable, ergonomic grip that does not feel slippery when wet. The buttons have a satisfying click with zero play, and the brush heads snap on with a tight, precise fit. It feels durable and well sealed against water, which is essential for long term use.
When it comes to performance, it leaves your teeth with that fresh, dentist clean feel every single time. The sonic vibration power is strong and consistent without feeling harsh on your gums, and the pressure sensor works like a charm to let you know if you are pressing too hard. Having the two brush heads included in the box is a great touch, making it ready for months of use right away.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "tomas wunderbar", "review_title": "Best electric toothbrush (when on sale)", "review_text": "I can feel my teeth thanking me at night for getting a step up in motor for my electric toothbrush. Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "j. brown", "review_title": "Absolutely Excellent Oral-B Electric Toothbrush with a Soft Brush Head", "review_text": "My family and I have been using Oral-B electric toothbrushes for many years. So expecting the great level of quality performance I ordered this one. I was not disappointed. This Oral-B IO is exceptional and arrived fully charged. Also, it did a great job cleaning my teeth leaving my mouth feeling fresh. There is only one small caveat there is only one brush head included and my old Oral-B brush heads do not fit the new toothbrush. There are several reviews that mention the single included brush head is stiff. I’ve not had the same experience. Perhaps I received a different brush head.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Mariya", "review_title": "A Game-Changer for My Dental Routine — Noticeable Results and Effortless to Use", "review_text": "⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I’ve been using this electric toothbrush for close to a year now, and I absolutely love it. Before this, I was using a regular manual toothbrush, and I truly had no idea what I was missing. The difference is enormous — this toothbrush cleans my teeth so much better and leaves my mouth feeling like I just left the dentist.
One of the things that really convinced me it was working was my six-month dental appointment. My hygienist actually commented on how clean my teeth looked compared to previous visits. I hadn’t changed anything else in my routine except for switching to this toothbrush, so that alone made me a believer.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Liz", "review_title": "Oral-B iO Series 2 Toothbrush", "review_text": "This is a great electric toothbrush, rechargeable, very quiet, with a soft brush", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "G. rum", "review_title": "Fantastic Product", "review_text": "I really enjoy my Oral-B it works great and cleans better then the standard old school toothbrush. The only thing I would like to see it have instead a smooth finish where you hold it a rough finish so it don't slip out of your hand. I guess it's ok like it is but for me personally if it had a serrated type grip it wouldn't slip out of my hand. I would recommend product it works great.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Abby Thompson", "review_title": "Various Setting", "review_text": "Great! Seller should have put all the neccessary description especially the power voltage since they are selling it globally. Other than that everything is good. Shipping only takes 7 days for this one and the peach/pink one is 9 days. Ordered both separately.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Esme", "review_title": "Great", "review_text": "Easy to use and great for beginners. My teeth have definitely been getting whiter from the settings. Would recommend!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Howright", "review_title": "Torn between this and the other brand", "review_text": "Been a Sonicare user for 10-15 years and decided I wanted to try the Oral B. I didn't want to spend a lot, so I found this one and ordered it.
Things I like:
Love circular motion of the brush instead of the up an down movement of the Sonicare.
Love that it has a sensor to alert you if you are brushing too hard. Such a simple feature and hopefully it shows on my next dental visit.
Battery seems to last a long time between charges. I am going on two weeks without charging which is great for travel.
Like that the handle stays cleaner compared to my older Sonicare because of how it is designed. Toothpaste and water run down it and does not have a place to collect.
Things I don't like:
The brush had by design traps water whereas the Sonicare brush design seems to drain water better. I rinse my toothbrush and then lay it brush side down on a towel to let it dry before standing it up on the counter or charger. If not, I worry about it not drying fully and things growing.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Jon Gonzalez", "review_title": "Amazing Brush and Heads", "review_text": "I finally updated my old Oral B Pro electric toothbrush that I have used for 10+ years when it was on sale during Prime days. I figured why switch if it wasn’t broken. But I had noticed the charging was not what it used to be and the outer plastic felt like it was getting loose.
I was shocked at how much cleaner my teeth felt with the Oral B Pro i02. I’m not sure that it is the brush, it might be the more expensive Oral B replacement brush heads. Either way you don’t need to buy the more expensive Oral B i09 with so many modes. The more reasonably priced i02 is all you need.
I may return the Waterpik flosser my hygienist recommended for easier flossing of my back teeth. I bought it for a great price during Prime days too. I haven’t opened the box yet. My new electric Oral B i02 toothbrush works so well, I think the waterpik is an extra step that maybe is no longer needed.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Steph", "review_title": "Teeth feel clean!", "review_text": "Bought 2 of these, one for myself and my husband. I also got them to help protect our gums because I had some recession from brushing too hard. I was worried about mixing up whose toothbrush was whose, but each brush head has a different symbol on it, so it's easy to tell apart.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "TGL", "review_title": "Great toothbrush with excellent battery life", "review_text": "Amazing tooth brush that was on sale and it works as expected. Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Katelyn", "review_title": "Crooked, Overcrowded, Yellow Teeth", "review_text": "Let me start this review by saying that when I was younger, much to my parent's dismay, I neglected to brush my teeth. I would brush them but not as often and as thoroughly as a child should. This was partly due to my very bad gag reflex and partly due to the fact that it felt painful (?). Anyway, I've had yellow teeth my whole life (I'm 29) because of it. I never got braces (thanks again gag reflex) but my parents tried everything to get me to have better oral hygiene and to have a more aesthetically pleasing smile. Now that I'm well into adulthood, my smile being so yellow, and also very crowded, was starting to bother me. I knew I had to give in and fix one or the other. (To be clear if you have crooked teeth don't feel like you have to change yourself just for society - after 29 years, I can say that I truly wanted to change the yellowness purely for myself). I've gotten healthier in almost all other aspects of my life. I decided to make the plunge and buy this in hopes it would help get my teeth cleaner and help reduce plaque buildup. Not just for aesthetics, but for actual oral hygiene.
So, I've used it twice a day for 3 days so far and my brother commented on how "white" my teeth look yesterday evening. That felt very good to hear, not gonna lie. I think this toothbrush is amazing for the price. I love how tiny the head of the brush is. It fits into my small, overcrowded mouth perfectly. I was worried that it would take forever to brush my teeth since I wasn't doing the work, the toothbrush was. However, it takes about 2 minutes and 30 seconds or 3 minutes if you're extra thorough. It allots 30 seconds to each section of your mouth, it will do a variation in the vibration to let you know when the 30 seconds is up and to move to the next portion of your mouth. It doesn't automatically shut off after 3 minutes (that I know of) if you want to go back and do another section of your mouth, which is nice. As for the pressure sensor on the toothbrush, mine does not work. It doesn't indicate any color or anything. It just appears to be a normal electric toothbrush. I may have gotten a "bad" toothbrush since it's not working, but to be honest, I truly just wanted something that would do a deep clean and this toothbrush does that. However, all the other reviews mention the sensor working so if that's something you're looking for, I would still highly recommend this toothbrush. I think mine might just be a dud in that department. The charging took several hours to be full on the first day. I keep it on the charger to ensure that it is always fully charged. If you don't have your charger with you and you need to rely on it without it, I'm told the battery lasts up to a week. Which, is very impressive for a $50 toothbrush. Amazon says that it has Bluetooth connectivity but I do not see any indication of that on the boxes or in the manual. My parents bought me an electric toothbrush when I was little, but I was too young to appreciate it. Now that I'm older, I think this is a great option for any person of any age. I do recommend it!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "CEH", "review_title": "Lasted 12 years before I had to buy it again! Superior clean without the hefty price.", "review_text": "After an incredible 12-year run with my first Oral-B Pro 1000, I finally bought it again!
The battery on my original brush finally bit the dust, and toward the end, it would only stay charged enough to get me through 24 hours of teeth brushing (if I was lucky) before dying. However, I loved the performance so much over the last decade that replacing it with the exact same model was an absolute no-brainer.
Here is why this brush is a classic:
Hygienist Approved: My dental hygienist once told me that it really doesn't matter how fancy or expensive an electric toothbrush is—any solid electric toothbrush is far superior to a manual brush. This model gives you that elite, professional clean without making you pay for unnecessary, over-hyped tech features.
The One Minor Con: If I have to name one downside, it is the noise. Even brand new out of the box, it does sound a bit like it might be powered by hamsters while it is working. But just because it doesn't sound whisper-quiet doesn't negate the fact that it is a remarkably solid, heavy-duty toothbrush.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amazon Customer", "review_title": "I love this toothbrush", "review_text": "I have used the Oral-B electric toothbrushes for many years. I’ve been told I have a small mouth and the small round head of this toothbrush is perfect for me. It makes every brushing like going to the hygienist—smooth clean teeth. It has a timer for a total of 2 minutes, with a change every 30 seconds to move you through the front and back of both sides of your mouth. I wouldn’t use any other toothbrush.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Kenenna Oyeka", "review_title": "Great everyday clean, but missing a couple of premium features", "review_text": "I’ve been using the Oral-B Pro 1000 for a few weeks now, and it does a fantastic job where it matters most: cleaning teeth. Coming from a manual toothbrush, the difference is night and day. My teeth feel incredibly smooth and "dentist-clean" after every use.
What I Like:
Powerful Cleaning: The oscillating CrossAction brush head really gets into the gaps and breaks up plaque effectively.
Pressure Sensor: The built-in pressure sensor is a great feature—it stops pulsing if you press too hard, protecting your gums.
2-Minute Timer: The handle pulses every 30 seconds to let you know when to switch quadrants, which makes it easy to stick to the recommended brushing time.
Room for Improvement:
Only One Mode: It only features a single, daily clean mode. If you have highly sensitive teeth, you might miss having a dedicated "sensitive" or lower-speed setting.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Lisa H", "review_title": "Great electric toothbrush but head replacement gets pricey!", "review_text": "Great, lightweight electric toothbrush with several different replacement heads to choose from. Lower upfront cost to purchase the toothbrush than other brands or models within the Oral-B family. Recharges fast and is easy to take on trips too. Only issue is with the price of replacement heads - that is where they get you. Just do your research as the brush heads need replacing every few months and it adds up.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Mattuccii", "review_title": "Don’t be frightened when your teeth feels clean for the first time!", "review_text": "Absolutely phenomenal. People weren’t lying when they said it feels like you just came from the dentist. I don’t know how it does it, but if you brush the same way you brush with a manual toothbrush, alongside the intense vibration, it feels like it removes 100% of plaque, especially the plaque that’s hard to get behind each tooth. Also, at first, the vibration may feel a little intense, but you’ll get used to it. But if it’s too strong, just press the button and it will go to a slower mode. I highly recommend the strongest mode for the most effectiveness. But hands down, this is the best toothbrush I’ve ever got in my life. I will say, because the brush is small, I usually apply the toothpaste on my finger and place it in my mouth manually, then brush. But that’s my personal preference. I just prefer more toothpaste. And it sits well on the charging pad. I honestly have no complaints.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Ejhersey", "review_title": "This is a bit pricy over time but it works well", "review_text": "Love this. Power runs about 5 uses for me. Good buy, only thing worth noting is that the new heads are like 15$ a pop which is expensive in the long haul.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amazon Customer", "review_title": "Excellent!", "review_text": "I love this brush and wish I had gotten one years ago! After learning from my hygienist how to use it correctly, this brush made brushing so much easier than a regular toothbrush and I can feel that the cleaning is so much more thorough. Love it. Well worth the ~$50 cost.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Jaber Alhussain", "review_title": "ممتاااااااااااااااز 👍", "review_text": "شكرا لكم على خدمتكم", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Zepherine", "review_title": "Great cleaning, versatile options for brush heads, charge lasts, but only 1 speed setting", "review_text": "One of my best purchases.
I used to clean my teeth with a manual toothbrush, thinking that if I spent enough time and diligence, it would provide the same level of cleaning as an electric toothbrush.
I was wrong.
After my very first cleaning with this device, I felt a level of clean teeth only experienced when I leave the dentist's office after a cleaning. And it wasn't just a subjective feeling. When I returned for my 6 month cleaning the next time, there was barely any tartar or plaque build up - all had been removed by this toothbrush. I also noticed that my level of bad breath and tonsil rocks declined significantly. Turns out a manual cleaning is nowhere near as good as this machine. I have purchased this toothbrush for familty and friends, telling them it has changed my life. I wish I had this device as a child!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Ali Khalid", "review_title": "ممتازه", "review_text": "جداً ممتازه", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Claudia", "review_title": "Limpieza profunda y guiada, excelente cepillo", "review_text": "He estado usando el Oral-B Pro 1000 CrossAction y me ha gustado mucho. La limpieza es más profunda que con un cepillo manual: ayuda a eliminar placa y cuidar las encías de manera más eficiente. El temporizador integrado facilita completar los dos minutos recomendados, guiando 30 segundos en cada cuadrante. Además, el cabezal redondo llega a zonas difíciles con mucha más facilidad que un cepillo convencional.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Diana", "review_title": "Excelente", "review_text": "Se siente la diferencia :)", "review_rating": ""}]

I was definitely correct because this new Philips Sonicare packs much more of a punch compared to my old one. It was almost a little too much at first but I just needed a couple of days to adjust and now it’s great. I’ve noticed my teeth feel incredibly smooth all day long, like they do immediately after I go for a cleaning at the dentist. Now I regret not updating sooner because I think this will be great for my dental hygiene.

The toothbrush leaves my teeth feeling much cleaner than a manual toothbrush, and I appreciate the built-in timer that helps me brush for the recommended amount of time. The different cleaning modes are easy to use, and the battery life has been excellent between charges.
As a retired pharmacist, I understand how important good oral hygiene is to overall health. Investing in a quality electric toothbrush has been well worth it, and seeing healthier gums has been the biggest benefit for me.

The matte black finish looks sleek on the bathroom counter, but more importantly, the build quality feels incredibly solid. Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Jeff S.", "review_title": "Great budget smartwatch", "review_text": "After 17 years in the Apple ecosystem, I recently switched from an iPhone to a Samsung S26 Ultra so I needed a watch that worked with my new Android phone to replace my Apple Watch. I wasn't ready to throw down $300+ on a Galaxy Watch just yet so I looked for cheaper alternatives and that's when I found the Galaxy FIT 3. It does all of the major functions I need from a smart watch (time/date/temperature, fitness tracking, basic notifications, media playback controls). It comes with 100 different pre-set watch faces to customize your watch but they cannot be individually customized nor can any more be downloaded. The band is soft and comfortable (I'm not sure if there are many replacement bands to customize your FIT like are available for Apple Watches). The watch itself is much narrower vertically and lighter than my Apple Watch. I have to recharge it every 5-7 days (nowhere near the 14 day claimed battery life but much better than when I had to recharge my Apple Watch every day). It takes about 30 seconds per 1 percent to recharge the battery. The biggest downgrades from the Apple Watch or other higher end smartwatches is the smaller size of the display and its reduced scratch resistance (I've already gotten several small scratches on the watch face within the first month of use). But for under $50, it's well worth it, despite any shortcomings.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amanda", "review_title": "Love at first sight", "review_text": "This watch is honestly almost perfect. I had a fit bit charge 4 before this one and it finally quit on me. I wanted a low budget option because I haven't been consistent and don't have 300 dollars to waste for it to sit around if I end up not staying consistent. For 50 dollars this beauty fits nearly all my needs. Paired to my samsung phone immediately when I pulled it out of the box. Super easy to set up, and tons of different ways to customize the watch face. Have I mentioned its so pretty?? I don't typically wear a watch but I wanted the health metrics to track my heart rate and steps. This is one of two mild caveats. It doesn't actively track your heart rate. Every couple minutes or so it pings your heart rate to get more of a time line than a live feed. No worries, it pings often enough you get a good idea. Only mildly sucks because I use the live feed heart rate monitor to help clue me in to if I might have a panic attack or if I'm overreacting. Another thing. I have been using google health to track my calories and set specific goals for some of my macros I'm trying to hit. Unfortunately, the samsung health app doesn't get this specific and just gives you the suggested daily intake as a metric rather than letting you set your own. What sucks more is that these two apps don't sync with each other. So now I have 2 seperate apps to track my health. All in all. Its really a fantastic little gadget. For $50 I would 10000% buy it again if they came out with a newer version.
