Imagine a fitness tracker that actually works and doesn't randomly stop mid day!! Another plus that I discovered by accident is my watch reminds me when I'm out of range of my phone. This helps me to remember to not leave my phone behind if I'm working outside or over at my son's house. I have gotten home and realized an hour later that my phone isn't in my bag. This watch vibrates right away when the phone isn't in range. As an older person this is a help for me. I want to have my phone nearby in case I have a medical issue. I also love the bigger screen and the watch is very responsive which was another frustration with my last fitness tracker. I love the long charge battery life. I doubt I'll ever go back to my prior fitness tracker as it was so maddening to NOT be able to figure out the issues and sometimes it would "wake up" and start working again. This Samsung Galaxy Fit 3 is easy to wear and provides the health tracking numbers that matter to me. Thumbs up.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Ericka", "review_title": "Cool Watch - UPDATE 2/17/26", "review_text": "I just received my watch today 2/15 it came fast as promised. I can already say that I like the watch. The color, it was easy to setup and pair to my S24 Ultra with no problems. It's slim, sleek, and cute on my wrist. When I got the watch it was already at 76% I used my phone to charge it to 100% I love the different functions the watch offers. You can adjust the brightness to your liking. In will update on the battery life after a week. It has many different options face changes for the watch and it's easy to read. And for the price it's really affordable. I'm not disappointed at all about purchasing this watch. I'm a HUGE FAN of Samsung products.

The accuracy of the sleep tracker is good. In the Samsung Health App it gives a breakdown of how many hours you slept, if you snoring it records your snoring and you can hear yourself snore. On "smart thing" samsung app it shows you where your watch is or you can go under the wear app and click on "find my band" and it'll take you right to the "smart things" app and it'll show you where your watch is located. Overall I'm satisfied with the watch. So many features. I changed my 5 star to 4 due to the misinformation on the battery life. Title: Levoit Air Purifiers for Bedroom Home Pets Dorm Room, Small Air Purifiers
Category: Home & Kitchen,Heating, Cooling & Air Quality,Air Purifiers
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Tee Bogitini", "review_title": "**★★★★★ Extremely Happy With This Little Air Purifier!★★★★★**", "review_text": "I wasn’t sure how much of a difference such a small air purifier would make, but I have to say, I’m really impressed with this one. It does exactly what I wanted it to do, and I’ve been very happy with it.
First of all, it’s really quiet. That was important to me because I didn’t want something that sounded like a fan running all day and night. I can have this going while I’m working, watching TV, or sleeping and barely notice it.
It’s also the perfect size. It doesn’t take up much room at all, but it still feels like it’s doing a great job keeping the air fresher. I love that I can just put it on a nightstand, desk, or dresser and pretty much forget it’s there.
The controls are super simple, and having three different fan speeds is nice depending on how much airflow I want. I also really like the aromatherapy feature. Adding a little essential oil is such a nice touch and makes the room smell fresh and relaxing.
Another thing I appreciate is that it doesn’t feel cheap or flimsy. It has a nice clean design, works exactly like it should, and there really isn’t anything complicated about using it.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Rheanna", "review_title": "Fingers crossed this helps my allergic dog!", "review_text": "I got this air purifier for my bedroom. My dog has a very severe dust mite allergy. He was literally disintegrating. His hair was falling out and his dandruff was like a blizzard. He had full body yeast and it smelled like a dirty gym sock on steroids.
Despite having no carpet, rugs and bedding that are washed weekly, and dust mite covers on both of our beds, he was still miserable. He is so allergic that out of desperation I'm trying everything I possibly can to minimize his exposure while his immunotherapy does its job.
The vet said that short of having hospital level air purification I would never get rid of all the dust mites, but I can limit his exposure with air purifiers, so we are giving it a try. There's no way I can accurately gauge how much this air purifier is reducing the dust mites, but it has to be better than it was before I got it.
My dog gets 3 medicated baths a week and is about to start immunotherapy, so I can't really credit any progress to the air purifier alone, but there is no doubt it will help reduce the total number of dust mites he is exposed to.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amazon Customer", "review_title": "Fresh Air", "review_text": "The air purifier gives me peace of mind as the air quality index numbers are rising. My best friend, my pup, is very sensitive to the particulates from the Canadian widfire smoke. This levoit has change the air in my bedroom. And my pup is clearly no longer suffering. The bedroom sanctuary is purified. Thank you! Also, quiet and takes up very little space. Just make sure you don't stack things next to it so the air flows and the machine can do its job.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Jim Gordon", "review_title": "Room capacity misrepresented", "review_text": "I have enjoyed my Levoit 300 for 7 years and it is still going strong. That is a heavy duty appliance with a heavy motor. This smaller model has the low 7 watt power efficiency going for it but when I received the box there is an agency rating stated on the side that this size is recommended for a 54 square foot room maximum! The instruction manual suggests no more than a 154 sq ft room for best results. My bedroom is a modest 100 sq ft. I get odors from my mini-split head unit and my CPAP and bedding. I will give this a chance to prove its worth based on many customer reviews. It is silent on the low speed and has a reasonably low noise level on medium. I got frustrated with the little control panel at first because it does not work the same way my larger 300 model works, you have to hit the power button to change the speed. I think it is silly to add 'phone' controls to something as simple as this. I'm having a great life without any smart phone addiction. On a positive note, a 4 pack of replacement filters for this model costs the same as a single filter for the larger model 300. There is a single aroma oil disk installed, I don't plan on using that feature.
I'm a retired electronics quality control engineer. I just went into my closed bedroom after 45 minutes of this filter in service on the medium speed - Impressed! The room smells much less stuffy, barely any dirty socks smell remains. I also use the small Hunter UV air sterilizer in the room and this filter pairs well with the sterilizer. I put this air cleaner directly under my AC head unit which is turned off during the day, the air flow can help to dry out the coils and reduce musty odors. I'm sticking with the 4 star rating because the product description is misleading as to room size capacity.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Mikey_Man_X", "review_title": "Surprised", "review_text": "So I was always skeptical about air purifiers and how effective they really were. Saw this was on sale, so I finally decided to give one a try and it actually makes a difference. My room collects dust due to all of my video game consoles and I've noticed there is less dust on my tv and gaming systems when I go to clean my room once a week. My room is on the smaller side at 11x11, so 121 square feet and this is plenty strong enough to get the job done. It was incredibly easy to set up and even on the highest setting, it's still pretty quiet. I've also noticed I've woken up less stuffy than I normally would have, so this actually does work. I'll definitely be buying a second one for my home gym room.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Jared Batiste", "review_title": "Perfect for a Bedroom", "review_text": "I’ve been really happy with this little air purifier. It’s compact enough to sit on a nightstand or dresser without taking up much space, and it runs quietly, especially at night. I’ve noticed the room smells fresher and there seems to be less dust floating around. Simple to use and works well for a smaller room.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Sherry fowler", "review_title": "Well worth the investment!", "review_text": "Great purifiers, customer service is top notch too, did not receive one unit and they were very helpful. I have 4 small units and one large unit for my 1,600 sq ft apt. Not needing to change my hvac filters as often and no more allergies!!! They emit a soothing white noise that actually helps me nod off to sleep. Highly recomend.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Richey Birchett", "review_title": "Works so well in the kitchen that I bought a second for the kids' room", "review_text": "It worked so well at removing cooking smells from our open-concept living space that I bought a second one for the kids' bedroom. It not only cleared the air in their room, but its soft air sound on the high setting makes a great white-noise machine to drown out the nighttime noises. It's virtually silent on the lower settings, but the kids like the white-noise effect of the high setting.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "あーる", "review_title": "コスパがよい", "review_text": "デザイン、価格、効果申し分ない。
今シーズンも突然発症し、就寝中に鼻水と涙が止まらなくなったので、寝室用にすぐ購入！
タイムセールでよかった。
とても静かである。
初日は、新車の中のような匂いがあったが、2日目は気にならない。設置してからは、症状も出ていない。", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Candy", "review_title": "Best buy", "review_text": "It's a great find❤️❤️❤️", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Mary", "review_title": "حلو بدون سلك", "review_text": "بدون سلك كهرباء", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Giulio", "review_title": "Piccolo e silenzioso", "review_text": "È piccolo, perciò non ci si può aspettare miracoli, ma se vengono rispettate le indicazioni del produttore utilizzandolo in stanze delle adeguate dimensioni, lavora benissimo, e purifica l'aria correttamente. Tutto sembra essere costruito con ottima qualità: plastiche, incastri, motore ventola ecc... Perfino il filtro sembra essere ben costruito e di qualità superiore rispetto ad altri della stessa fascia di prezzo. Ha una regolazione di 3 velocità delle quali solo la massima è rumorosa ma non molto fastidiosa, infatti la velocità intermedia è appena udibile (pari ad un soffio) e mai fastidiosa anche stando nelle vicinanze. Alla prima velocità è praticamente impossibile udire qualcosa e questo è un pregio ENORME rispetto ad altri purificatori in commercio della stessa categoria. Questa velocità si presta benissimo per il riposo notturno. Nessun ronzio o rumore. Questo, forse, credo sia possibile anche grazie al motore/ventola in corrente continua, infatti il purificatore viene fornito di un piccolo alimentatore che si trova nella confezione. In essa vengono forniti anche 3 "feltri" per la diffusione delle essenze naturali da inserire in un apposito cassetto laterale quasi invisibile. Nel complesso quindi un ottimo purificatore poco ingombrante, con un buon rapporto qualità prezzo e soprattutto poco rumoroso e che vale la pena acquistare.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Shining Scrutiny", "review_title": "LEVOIT Air Purifiers for Bedroom Home - Core Mini Review", "review_text": "In today's world, where indoor air quality is a growing concern, having a reliable air purifier can make a real difference, especially if you deal with allergies, pet dander, or just want fresher air. The LEVOIT Air Purifier Core Mini caught my attention because of its compact size and features. I picked up the white version, and I've been using it primarily on my office desk. After a good period of use, I can confidently say it's a very good air purifier.
Pros:", "review_rating": ""}]

Title: Levoit Air Purifier for Home Pets Bedroom Dorm Room, Smart & Voice Control
Category: Home & Kitchen,Heating, Cooling & Air Quality,Air Purifiers
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Lisa C", "review_title": "Affordable and effective for dust and allergens", "review_text": "We moved into an incredibly dusty townhouse, I have terrible allergies, and we discovered our neighbors are chain smokers. We now have 3 Levoit air purifiers in our home: Vital 100 (non-smart version), Core Mini and Vital 200S.
I initially bought the Vital 100 and put it in our bedroom because I have terrible allergies. It collected a ton of dust and helped a lot with the allergies. I thought I didn't need the smart version but in hindsight the availability of specialty filters and the remote control would be very helpful. It's relatively quiet although on high it's too noisy for me to sleep with. I absolutely love that you can turn the all the control lights off. We tried using this for the cigarette smell but it wasn't very effective except when the smell was very light. It did completely abolish cooking smells though. If I could go back in time I would have ordered the 100S instead but this one works fine.
The smoke smell from the neighbors comes into our house through the laundry room which is a very small room. I bought the Core Mini to try to combat it. The Core Mini doesn't really do much to get rid of smells and was definitely overwhelmed by the smoke so now we move it around the house now when the pollen level is high. It works ok for dust and allergens but the range isn't great; you need to be right next to it to notice a difference. On low and medium speed it's barely audible and high is relatively quiet but overall the fan isn't very powerful. The lights on this one automatically turn off after a few seconds making it bedroom friendly. If I could do it again, I would have skipped this one and bought one of the larger ones sooner.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "RAERAE", "review_title": "Best Purchase All Year", "review_text": "I simply cannot say ENOUGH good things about this product! After 2 weeks of use the air feels lighter, I no longer wake up with a stuffy nose or junk in my lungs and I bought the pet specific air filters that are an added bonus. I LOVE the lighting features and that you can sync the device to my phone and set up schedules so it's quiet at night. The controls are SUPER easy to use and fool proof.
Just don't forget to open the base when you get it and take the plastic packaging off around the air filter!!! I forgot to do this and wondered why there was no air flow coming out of the top till I Googled it. 😂😂😂", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Robert Blackorbay", "review_title": "great replacement for my bedroom", "review_text": "I use this in a room I use to have an Ionic air purifier, the old worked there was some dust near the unit, but the smell of Ozone was too much since i kept my door closed most of the day. the Levoit was a perfect replacement, no smell, lot less noise and my room felt refreshed when i open the door. I have the 330 model for over 2 years in the Livingroom and i happy with that one as well. the only down i don't like is the 300 can sense the air and adjust where the 200 can't, but you can program to go on or off multi times throughout the day, the night light is a nice touch for when it's in my sons room or i want to see enough light in a pitch black room. fits perfect in my bedroom, cleans the air, no dusty or ozone smell. very effective for the rom it is in.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Alimistar", "review_title": "Great small sized air purifier that does some heavy lifting", "review_text": "I got this air purifier for my bedroom as my sleep can be disturbed by air quality pretty easily. I was highly skeptical of this product at first as the price point to me indicated that it might be cheap in terms of quality of the product but so far it has been pretty impressive. On even the lowest setting, it has substantially improved the air quality not just in the bedroom but in the adjoining room so we're looking at space of about 200-300 square feet or so. I would say I can breathe easier at night with it and my comfort level while sleeping has increased a bit.
The air after it's been running for a bit smells and just seems fresher and I am considering getting a second one to see if it can handle a much larger area.
Noise is pretty low on it's lowest "normal" setting and the night mode feature drops the noise to almost silent, but not quite. At it's lowest setting, there is an odd whine, for lack of better words that can just barely be heard. This whine was an annoyance at first but you get used to and can ignore it. It still works well on the lowest setting to keep the room fresh so it's a good deal.
Setup was easy as can physically, however I cannot as yet speak to the application setup as I haven't gotten to that. I treat air purifiers as non-smart devices but I do plan to at least try to integrate it with Home Assistant and if that doesn't work I may try integration with Amazon Alexa. I'll update the review when that happens.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "easybreezy6", "review_title": "Skeptical About Used? This Changed My Mind", "review_text": "I chose the Amazon box option mainly so I could check whether the item shipped safely and arrived without damage to the outer packaging. The Amazon box itself arrived in good condition, but the Core 200S-P’s box was damaged, likely because it had not been handled carefully during a previous shipment.
Since I bought it in Used – Acceptable condition, I inspected the purifier carefully. I found no issues with the unit itself. It came with what appears to be a new filter, had no strange smell, and works perfectly, just like my other Core 300S-P, which I recently bought new.
I also bought a second unit in Used – Good condition. The only thing I noticed was a black scuff mark on the bottom of the purifier, as shown in the pictures, but it does not look like actual damage. The box for that one also appeared to have been damaged during a previous shipment. From my experience buying used items on Amazon, that seems fairly common, and it is probably one reason the price is lower when the manufacturer’s box is damaged.
I ran it for an hour on level 3, the highest fan speed and it seems to be working perfectly. Afterward, the room smelled cleaner and felt easier to breathe in. I also found no visual issues.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Jen", "review_title": "1000% RECOMMEND!", "review_text": "I bought this purifier because I really wanted one that I could turn on from my phone while laying in bed, since I am completely blind in the dark due to my vision impairment, and I don't necessarily have anywhere to place this type of electronic near my bed that was the major deal breaker for me. This air purifier is about the size of a PS5, but a little more convenient due to the cylinidrical shape of it. The app set up is easy and it allows you to auto order a new filter through the app via a scheduled set up. I have mine set up for every 6 months and you can tell the difference between the 2 filters after those 6 months.... the app also will tell you the life on your filter left and will tell you the air quality/ pollen count outside of your home. All the modes do exactly as they say and the sleep mode is ultra quiet which is nice. I've been using this air purifier for almost 2 years now and it is still working great. You can immidetly tell when you take it out of the box that it is a good high quality purifier and not a purifier where they say its high quality and after a week it stops working... My last purifier was lmof a lower quality and stopped working with-in a year, but also I paid $50 for that one and I didn't have a dog at that time.
It is so nice to have a higher quality purifier that works exactly as it says on the ads. The app also includes other Levoit electronics you can add to your account so you have all your Lwvoit products in one spot on your phone which I think is so mice and easy. The app is also really easy to use and to set up everything on, it looks and feels very professional and easy which I really enjoy. I love opening up my app and seeing all my Levoit electronics in one spot, ready to turn on or off, or to change any mode it's on to something different. You can aslo set up a schedule of when you would like your devices to turn on and off and what mode to use whenbit does.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "lej", "review_title": "My 1st Levoit is "Le Bon" - Good quality,, easy to use", "review_text": "Highly recommend it so far - have only used it the past week BUT it is during the worst air quality in the world time in Chicago from the Canadian and Minnesota wildfires. It really seems to be working, helping. Easy to put together - no actual assembly required. Nice and small, very quiet (sound free on sleep), and you should totally download the recommended app. I wasn't thinking I would, but so helpful and serves like a remote almost. Already recommended to 2 friends and another who bought it already. Good product so far!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "KW", "review_title": "Surprisingly effective — glad I stuck with it", "review_text": "This was my first time ever using an air purifier, so I was pretty skeptical even after reading all the good reviews. The first few days were honestly a little discouraging because my bedroom still smelled kind of funky. I live in an older house, and getting certain smells out of the rooms has been a big priority while I finish setting everything up.
But after about a week, the difference became really noticeable. Now it’s actually refreshing to walk into my room. I’m really glad I didn’t give up on it early.
I also share my bedroom with a Husky, and there’s no dog smell anymore — which is huge. The fan is pretty quiet, and even when I turn it up, the sound is kind of soothing. It actually reminds me of the ocean waves from my trip to Ormond, FL, which is a nice little bonus.
The filters are easy to insert and remove (I haven’t had to replace mine yet, but I tested it out just to see), and the whole unit feels simple and user‑friendly.
Overall, very happy with this purifier. It took a little time, but it absolutely did its job.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Hein?", "review_title": "Indispensable.", "review_text": "Je ne sais pas par où commencer, mais en tout cas, je suis super satisfait. L'appareil a un joli design et on sent la qualité. Sur l'écran tactile, il y a tout ce qu'il faut.
Ce que j'adore, c'est le fait qu'il soit connecté à l'application. Elle est vraiment super simple et complète sans en faire trop. On peut voir sur les photos qu'il est indiqué quand il faut changer le filtre (par exemple, il affiche 100 % quand il est neuf) ; on peut donc suivre son état d'usure au fur et à mesure.
En plus, juste en dessous, tout est prévu :
1. Il y a un lien « acheter le filtre »
2. Ce lien vous redirige directement sur Amazon
3. Le filtre coûte actuellement 25 €, ce qui n'est pas trop cher puisqu'il faut le changer tous les 3 à 6 mois
C'est vraiment bien pensé. La notice est en français, mais j'avoue qu'on n'en a pas vraiment besoin car tout est expliqué étape par étape dans l'application.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "barney", "review_title": "Fresh air.........", "review_text": "Our vet has this air purifier in each of their exam rooms, what a difference it makes. I bought one for the laundry room as we have a new puppy. You can sense the fresh air straight away. Great purchase.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Henry", "review_title": "I Looove it!!", "review_text": "Just love it and cools the room when active. Integrated with Alexa and so far it's been working really well.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "David O Neill", "review_title": "WARNING WARNING WARNING", "review_text": "I've made a complaint to amazon supoprt.
If you haven't noticed it like my this product is not European, its American and 110 volts.
No idea why they are listing it on European site without sufficient warning.
Better tittle might be
Levoit Vital 100 Air Purifiers (110 volt US)", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Isaac Olmedo", "review_title": "Excelente", "review_text": "El producto llegó a tiempo y en buen estado. Aunque el manual viene en inglés, es súper sencillo hacer el montaje y encenderlo. Tener la app en el celular hace más fácil controlarlo y pude conectarlo con Alexa sin ningún problema, además de que en la app te avisan el tiempo de vida que tiene el filtro, para poder monitorearlo y cambiarlo cuando sea necesario.
El purificador me ha funcionado muy bien, tiene 3 niveles, el más alto es el más ruidoso aunque no es molesto, muy parecido al ruido generado por un ventilador, el modo para dormir es una maravilla, prácticamente no se escucha nada y puedes programar a qué hora se apaga lo que me parece muy práctico.
Cuando llegó lo encendí en la recámara y una hora después ya notaba la diferencia en el aire, tengo alergias y sentía el aire más fresco para respirar y dormí muy a gusto sin estornudos ni tos. El filtro lo limpié con la aspiradora y fue muy sencillo, aunque no se elimina todo el polvo que se acumula, si se lleva gran parte lo que sin duda ayuda a que dure y filtre mejor por más tiempo.
Sí lo recomiendo, cumple bien su función y no considero que el precio sea excesivo.", "review_rating": ""}]

**Noise**

It does exactly what I wanted it to do, and I’ve been very happy with it.
First of all, it’s really quiet. That was important to me because I didn’t want something that sounded like a fan running all day and night. I can have this going while I’m working, watching TV, or sleeping and barely notice it.
It’s also the perfect size. It doesn’t take up much room at all, but it still feels like it’s doing a great job keeping the air fresher. I love that I can just put it on a nightstand, desk, or dresser and pretty much forget it’s there.
The controls are super simple, and having three different fan speeds is nice depending on how much airflow I want. I also really like the aromatherapy feature. Adding a little essential oil is such a nice touch and makes the room smell fresh and relaxing.
Another thing I appreciate is that it doesn’t feel cheap or flimsy. It has a nice clean design, works exactly like it should, and there really isn’t anything complicated about using it.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Rheanna", "review_title": "Fingers crossed this helps my allergic dog!", "review_text": "I got this air purifier for my bedroom. He had full body yeast and it smelled like a dirty gym sock on steroids.
Despite having no carpet, rugs and bedding that are washed weekly, and dust mite covers on both of our beds, he was still miserable. He is so allergic that out of desperation I'm trying everything I possibly can to minimize his exposure while his immunotherapy does its job.
The vet said that short of having hospital level air purification I would never get rid of all the dust mites, but I can limit his exposure with air purifiers, so we are giving it a try. There's no way I can accurately gauge how much this air purifier is reducing the dust mites, but it has to be better than it was before I got it.

Just make sure you don't stack things next to it so the air flows and the machine can do its job.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Jim Gordon", "review_title": "Room capacity misrepresented", "review_text": "I have enjoyed my Levoit 300 for 7 years and it is still going strong. That is a heavy duty appliance with a heavy motor. This smaller model has the low 7 watt power efficiency going for it but when I received the box there is an agency rating stated on the side that this size is recommended for a 54 square foot room maximum! The instruction manual suggests no more than a 154 sq ft room for best results. My bedroom is a modest 100 sq ft. I get odors from my mini-split head unit and my CPAP and bedding. I will give this a chance to prove its worth based on many customer reviews. It is silent on the low speed and has a reasonably low noise level on medium. I got frustrated with the little control panel at first because it does not work the same way my larger 300 model works, you have to hit the power button to change the speed. I think it is silly to add 'phone' controls to something as simple as this. I'm having a great life without any smart phone addiction. On a positive note, a 4 pack of replacement filters for this model costs the same as a single filter for the larger model 300. There is a single aroma oil disk installed, I don't plan on using that feature.
I'm a retired electronics quality control engineer. I just went into my closed bedroom after 45 minutes of this filter in service on the medium speed - Impressed! The room smells much less stuffy, barely any dirty socks smell remains. I also use the small Hunter UV air sterilizer in the room and this filter pairs well with the sterilizer. It's virtually silent on the lower settings, but the kids like the white-noise effect of the high setting.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "あーる", "review_title": "コスパがよい", "review_text": "デザイン、価格、効果申し分ない。

とても静かである。
初日は、新車の中のような匂いがあったが、2日目は気にならない。設置してからは、症状も出ていない。", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Candy", "review_title": "Best buy", "review_text": "It's a great find❤️❤️❤️", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Mary", "review_title": "حلو بدون سلك", "review_text": "بدون سلك كهرباء", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Giulio", "review_title": "Piccolo e silenzioso", "review_text": "È piccolo, perciò non ci si può aspettare miracoli, ma se vengono rispettate le indicazioni del produttore utilizzandolo in stanze delle adeguate dimensioni, lavora benissimo, e purifica l'aria correttamente. Tutto sembra essere costruito con ottima qualità: plastiche, incastri, motore ventola ecc... Perfino il filtro sembra essere ben costruito e di qualità superiore rispetto ad altri della stessa fascia di prezzo. Ha una regolazione di 3 velocità delle quali solo la massima è rumorosa ma non molto fastidiosa, infatti la velocità intermedia è appena udibile (pari ad un soffio) e mai fastidiosa anche stando nelle vicinanze. Alla prima velocità è praticamente impossibile udire qualcosa e questo è un pregio ENORME rispetto ad altri purificatori in commercio della stessa categoria. Questa velocità si presta benissimo per il riposo notturno. Nessun ronzio o rumore. Questo, forse, credo sia possibile anche grazie al motore/ventola in corrente continua, infatti il purificatore viene fornito di un piccolo alimentatore che si trova nella confezione. In essa vengono forniti anche 3 "feltri" per la diffusione delle essenze naturali da inserire in un apposito cassetto laterale quasi invisibile. Nel complesso quindi un ottimo purificatore poco ingombrante, con un buon rapporto qualità prezzo e soprattutto poco rumoroso e che vale la pena acquistare.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Shining Scrutiny", "review_title": "LEVOIT Air Purifiers for Bedroom Home - Core Mini Review", "review_text": "In today's world, where indoor air quality is a growing concern, having a reliable air purifier can make a real difference, especially if you deal with allergies, pet dander, or just want fresher air. The LEVOIT Air Purifier Core Mini caught my attention because of its compact size and features. I picked up the white version, and I've been using it primarily on my office desk. After a good period of use, I can confidently say it's a very good air purifier.
Pros:", "review_rating": ""}]

The toothbrush itself has good vibration, with different strength levels and modes, so I think it definitely gets the job done. The color is very pretty (I got pink), and it comes with 4 brush heads total.
The water floss machine is very portable. It is easy to hold in your hand without being too bulky, and the water tank holds a sufficient amount. If you're still figuring out the water flossing technique like me, you may have to refill the tank once during use, but once I get the hang of it I'm sure I can stretch one tank for a single session. The water flosser comes with 4 heads total, one of them being a tongue scraper.
Aside from the products and their attachments, they do not come with any sort of travel accessories. The toothbrush has a little cap that covers the end of it when there is no brush head attached, and the water flosser has space in the tank to attach 2 (i think?) heads to carry. I normally brush on the days he is off and sleeps in later than me on the weekends. The quality of the product is good. It reaches all areas and I like that it has a built in timer that makes it go off when you have brushed for long enough. The water flows is amazing on my gums and teeth. I love that I can choose my level of intensity. It does exactly what it was made to do. I am amazed at how much better my teeth and gums feel. I love the pink color. Es bastante práctico que sea un sistema 2 en 1 porque en un solo dispositivo tienes el cepillo eléctrico para la limpieza diaria y el irrigador dental para limpiar entre los dientes, algo que normalmente solo se logra bien con hilo dental o aparatos aparte.

La vibración del cabezal es suave pero efectiva, y la sensación de limpieza es mucho mejor que la de un cepillo manual tradicional.
El irrigador bucal es, sin duda, el punto fuerte de este pack. Tiene seis intensidades ajustables, por lo que se puede personalizar la presión del chorro de agua en función de la sensibilidad de cada usuario. El depósito de 300 ml es suficiente para una sesión completa sin necesidad de rellenarlo y las boquillas intercambiables facilitan la limpieza entre los dientes. Es especialmente útil para eliminar los restos de comida que el cepillado normal suele dejar atrás.
Su diseño compacto y su agarre antideslizante lo hacen cómodo de usar y fácil de guardar en el baño o de llevar de viaje. La batería recargable tiene buena autonomía, aunque me habría gustado que la conexión de carga fuera USB-C en ambos dispositivos, ya que actualmente cada uno requiere un cable distinto. Además, la base de carga no tiene una goma protectora, por lo que conviene mantenerla seca para evitar daños.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Gez", "review_title": "overall good product", "review_text": "The water flosser is great and features multiple modes. ELECTRIC TOOTHBRUSH-

Title: Men Smart Watch for Android iOS, Bluetooth Calls Voice Chat with Heart Rate/Sleep Monitor Fitness Tracker, 1.3" Full Touch Screen IP67 Waterproof Stainless Steel Activity Tracker for Men
Category: Electronics,Wearable Technology,Smartwatches
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Jeff", "review_title": "Great smartwatch", "review_text": "For the price, this smartwatch honestly exceeded my expectations. Setup was quick with my phone, and the watch connected to Bluetooth without any issues. Notifications come through clearly for calls, texts, and apps, which is mainly what I wanted it for.
The screen is bright and easy to read, even outside, and the battery life has been surprisingly good compared to other budget smartwatches I’ve tried. I can usually go several days before needing to charge it again.
I also like how lightweight and comfortable it feels on the wrist. It doesn’t look cheap, and the design actually has a clean modern look that works for both casual wear and workouts. The fitness tracking features seem pretty accurate for steps, heart rate, and daily activity.
The app is simple enough to use, and syncing data has been smooth so far. Obviously it’s not going to compete with a super expensive premium smartwatch, but for the cost it offers a lot of useful features.
Overall, this is a solid budget-friendly smartwatch if you want notifications, fitness tracking, and good battery life without spending hundreds of dollars.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "SSP", "review_title": "Great, Cheap Watch", "review_text": "This is a great, cheap watch. In the past, I had an expensive Android watch but accidentally washed in the washing machine. After that incident, I decided not to get another one until now. For around 50 bucks, this is incredible. My phone immediately paired with the watch, and everything loaded fine. The phone app allows you to easily change settings and download new watch faces with dozens of available faces to choose from on the app. I purchased the one with the beige leather band, and I think this looks better than the Android watch I spent 350 dollars on a few years ago. Connectivity so far has been great with text messages, emails, calls, alerts, etc... popping up with no issue. The display is good and the battery life seems average with it lasting a few days before needing to recharge. The health functions appear to work okay, but I have never put much stock in getting vitals from a watch. You can also listen to music on it with my Pandora playlists syncing perfectly to it. The sound for music and calls is average at best, but I did not purchase this to listen to music on. 5 Stars for price and functionality!", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Wolfstep", "review_title": "Decent watch for the money 💰", "review_text": "Over all its not a bad watch.
Battery for me iaated 5 days which was impressive.

Overall it's a $49 watch, so it fits what it costs.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "William McCarver", "review_title": "Don't spend hundreds of dollars on a smartwatch before you try this one", "review_text": "When I was looking to buy a new smartwatch because my tic watch died. It's very comfortable and I wear it everyday. At $60 I can buy another one for a spare", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Kyle Glassco", "review_title": "Cheap material and a lack of customer service.", "review_text": "9/28/23
Let me start by saying that I wanted to love this watch, and I truly did for several months.
I ordered this watch in February and chose it specifically because of the stainless steel band(can't stand those rubber smartwatch bands) and also because it's aesthetic is far more traditional and low-key than the mainstream smart watches.
Considering it is roughly 1/4th of the price of name brand smart watches, I fully expected it to not be perfect. After all, you get what you pay for. I expected some flaws and I was absolutely okay with that for the price.
Originally, I really liked it. I liked the simplicity of the watch, app, and settings. I was able to adjust everything to where I wanted it and the fully customizable face screen was fun to design. I even put a meme on it which was a huge hit with my friends. [{"reviewer_name": "Jeff S.", "review_title": "Great budget smartwatch", "review_text": "After 17 years in the Apple ecosystem, I recently switched from an iPhone to a Samsung S26 Ultra so I needed a watch that worked with my new Android phone to replace my Apple Watch. I did fail on not making sure that it works with android and iphone. the appearance is okay for a cheap watch. durability is top tier. (I don't want to pay smart watch prices.)
Out of the box, the Fit 3 was in Spanish, but when I put it on the charger, it reverted to English. It stayed English until I got a new phone and had to reset the tracker in order to pair it with the new phone. The tracker reverted to Spanish and putting it on the charger did not change that this time. I pressed the top option on the device's screen and got to choose from a whole list of languages. I chose English, but this is where someone who wants another language will find it.
The charge on this item is supposed to last up to 13 days. I've had this device for 3 months, and I got 6 days out of each charge (7 if I let the device die) for the first 2 months or so. Now, it last 4-5 days. I don't have the display always on and I don't consider my use of this device heavy by any means. 6 days is what I got out of my most recent Fitbit.
My Fit 3 charges from 20% to 70% in about 20 minutes and to 100% in about an hour. Title: SAMSUNG Galaxy FIT 3 [2024] 1.6" AMOLED Display | 14 Days Battery Life | 100+ Watchfaces | 100+ Exercise Modes | International Model - (Gray)
Description: Vibrant 1.6” AMOLED Display – Large, high-res screen with smooth touch for easy navigation
Reviews:
[{"reviewer_name": "Jeff S.", "review_title": "Great budget smartwatch", "review_text": "After 17 years in the Apple ecosystem, I recently switched from an iPhone to a Samsung S26 Ultra so I needed a watch that worked with my new Android phone to replace my Apple Watch. I wasn't ready to throw down $300+ on a Galaxy Watch just yet so I looked for cheaper alternatives and that's when I found the Galaxy FIT 3. It does all of the major functions I need from a smart watch (time/date/temperature, fitness tracking, basic notifications, media playback controls). It comes with 100 different pre-set watch faces to customize your watch but they cannot be individually customized nor can any more be downloaded. The band is soft and comfortable (I'm not sure if there are many replacement bands to customize your FIT like are available for Apple Watches). The watch itself is much narrower vertically and lighter than my Apple Watch. I have to recharge it every 5-7 days (nowhere near the 14 day claimed battery life but much better than when I had to recharge my Apple Watch every day). It takes about 30 seconds per 1 percent to recharge the battery. The biggest downgrades from the Apple Watch or other higher end smartwatches is the smaller size of the display and its reduced scratch resistance (I've already gotten several small scratches on the watch face within the first month of use). But for under $50, it's well worth it, despite any shortcomings.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amanda", "review_title": "Love at first sight", "review_text": "This watch is honestly almost perfect. Literally like a 9/10. The design is sleek, the watch face is not too big for my tiny wrist, has a vibrant and attractive display, and the watch band is really nice and soft! I had a fit bit charge 4 before this one and it finally quit on me. I wanted a low budget option because I haven't been consistent and don't have 300 dollars to waste for it to sit around if I end up not staying consistent. For 50 dollars this beauty fits nearly all my needs. Paired to my samsung phone immediately when I pulled it out of the box. Super easy to set up, and tons of different ways to customize the watch face. Have I mentioned its so pretty?? I don't typically wear a watch but I wanted the health metrics to track my heart rate and steps. This is one of two mild caveats. It doesn't actively track your heart rate. Every couple minutes or so it pings your heart rate to get more of a time line than a live feed. No worries, it pings often enough you get a good idea. Only mildly sucks because I use the live feed heart rate monitor to help clue me in to if I might have a panic attack or if I'm overreacting. Another thing. I have been using google health to track my calories and set specific goals for some of my macros I'm trying to hit. Unfortunately, the samsung health app doesn't get this specific and just gives you the suggested daily intake as a metric rather than letting you set your own. What sucks more is that these two apps don't sync with each other. So now I have 2 seperate apps to track my health. All in all. Its really a fantastic little gadget. For $50 I would 10000% buy it again if they came out with a newer version. Will update again after I've had it a few weeks.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Frontiergalsavesdogs", "review_title": "Fits comfortably on my wrist, easy to read bright colored perfect size screen", "review_text": "Arrived quicker than scheduled so that was a nice surprise. I love the soft pink color and I also like the larger screen. My last fitness tracker was smaller screen. This looks similar to a well known expensive brand watch. I just got it today and got right to programming it so I could start wearing it. I can't rate it on durability or accuracy yet but I sure hope it will be more reliable than my last fitness tracker which I won't mention the brand. I like the brightness of the screen which I find easier to read outdoors. UPDATE: Samsung Galaxy Fit 3 (2024) review continued: I'm quite pleased with this item as it seems to actually work each day! Imagine a fitness tracker that actually works and doesn't randomly stop mid day!! Another plus that I discovered by accident is my watch reminds me when I'm out of range of my phone. This helps me to remember to not leave my phone behind if I'm working outside or over at my son's house. I have gotten home and realized an hour later that my phone isn't in my bag. This watch vibrates right away when the phone isn't in range. As an older person this is a help for me. I want to have my phone nearby in case I have a medical issue. I also love the bigger screen and the watch is very responsive which was another frustration with my last fitness tracker. I love the long charge battery life. I doubt I'll ever go back to my prior fitness tracker as it was so maddening to NOT be able to figure out the issues and sometimes it would "wake up" and start working again. This Samsung Galaxy Fit 3 is easy to wear and provides the health tracking numbers that matter to me. Thumbs up.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Ericka", "review_title": "Cool Watch - UPDATE 2/17/26", "review_text": "I just received my watch today 2/15 it came fast as promised. I can already say that I like the watch. The color, it was easy to setup and pair to my S24 Ultra with no problems. It's slim, sleek, and cute on my wrist. When I got the watch it was already at 76% I used my phone to charge it to 100% I love the different functions the watch offers. You can adjust the brightness to your liking. In will update on the battery life after a week. It has many different options face changes for the watch and it's easy to read. And for the price it's really affordable. I'm not disappointed at all about purchasing this watch. I'm a HUGE FAN of Samsung products.
Update 2/17 - I wanted to vive an update after me having the watch since Sunday afternoon 2/15. The battery life does not live up to as it is advertised for 13 days. You'll probably get about 4 or maybe 5 days at best. Right now as I'm updating my review on this watch I'm at 39% and it's Tuesday evening 2/17 so I know maybe tomorrow I'll have to charge it. [{"reviewer_name": "Tee Bogitini", "review_title": "**★★★★★ Extremely Happy With This Little Air Purifier!★★★★★**", "review_text": "I wasn’t sure how much of a difference such a small air purifier would make, but I have to say, I’m really impressed with this one. It does exactly what I wanted it to do, and I’ve been very happy with it.
First of all, it’s really quiet. That was important to me because I didn’t want something that sounded like a fan running all day and night. I can have this going while I’m working, watching TV, or sleeping and barely notice it.
It’s also the perfect size. It doesn’t take up much room at all, but it still feels like it’s doing a great job keeping the air fresher. I love that I can just put it on a nightstand, desk, or dresser and pretty much forget it’s there.
The controls are super simple, and having three different fan speeds is nice depending on how much airflow I want. I also really like the aromatherapy feature. Adding a little essential oil is such a nice touch and makes the room smell fresh and relaxing.
Another thing I appreciate is that it doesn’t feel cheap or flimsy. It has a nice clean design, works exactly like it should, and there really isn’t anything complicated about using it.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Rheanna", "review_title": "Fingers crossed this helps my allergic dog!", "review_text": "I got this air purifier for my bedroom. My dog has a very severe dust mite allergy. He was literally disintegrating. His hair was falling out and his dandruff was like a blizzard. He had full body yeast and it smelled like a dirty gym sock on steroids.
Despite having no carpet, rugs and bedding that are washed weekly, and dust mite covers on both of our beds, he was still miserable. He is so allergic that out of desperation I'm trying everything I possibly can to minimize his exposure while his immunotherapy does its job.
The vet said that short of having hospital level air purification I would never get rid of all the dust mites, but I can limit his exposure with air purifiers, so we are giving it a try. There's no way I can accurately gauge how much this air purifier is reducing the dust mites, but it has to be better than it was before I got it.
My dog gets 3 medicated baths a week and is about to start immunotherapy, so I can't really credit any progress to the air purifier alone, but there is no doubt it will help reduce the total number of dust mites he is exposed to.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Amazon Customer", "review_title": "Fresh Air", "review_text": "The air purifier gives me peace of mind as the air quality index numbers are rising. My best friend, my pup, is very sensitive to the particulates from the Canadian widfire smoke. This levoit has change the air in my bedroom. And my pup is clearly no longer suffering. The bedroom sanctuary is purified. Thank you! Also, quiet and takes up very little space. Just make sure you don't stack things next to it so the air flows and the machine can do its job.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Jim Gordon", "review_title": "Room capacity misrepresented", "review_text": "I have enjoyed my Levoit 300 for 7 years and it is still going strong. That is a heavy duty appliance with a heavy motor. This smaller model has the low 7 watt power efficiency going for it but when I received the box there is an agency rating stated on the side that this size is recommended for a 54 square foot room maximum! The instruction manual suggests no more than a 154 sq ft room for best results. My bedroom is a modest 100 sq ft. I get odors from my mini-split head unit and my CPAP and bedding. I will give this a chance to prove its worth based on many customer reviews. It is silent on the low speed and has a reasonably low noise level on medium. I got frustrated with the little control panel at first because it does not work the same way my larger 300 model works, you have to hit the power button to change the speed. I think it is silly to add 'phone' controls to something as simple as this. I'm having a great life without any smart phone addiction. On a positive note, a 4 pack of replacement filters for this model costs the same as a single filter for the larger model 300. There is a single aroma oil disk installed, I don't plan on using that feature.
I'm a retired electronics quality control engineer. I just went into my closed bedroom after 45 minutes of this filter in service on the medium speed - Impressed! The room smells much less stuffy, barely any dirty socks smell remains. I also use the small Hunter UV air sterilizer in the room and this filter pairs well with the sterilizer. I put this air cleaner directly under my AC head unit which is turned off during the day, the air flow can help to dry out the coils and reduce musty odors. I'm sticking with the 4 star rating because the product description is misleading as to room size capacity.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Mikey_Man_X", "review_title": "Surprised", "review_text": "So I was always skeptical about air purifiers and how effective they really were. Saw this was on sale, so I finally decided to give one a try and it actually makes a difference. My room collects dust due to all of my video game consoles and I've noticed there is less dust on my tv and gaming systems when I go to clean my room once a week. My room is on the smaller side at 11x11, so 121 square feet and this is plenty strong enough to get the job done. It was incredibly easy to set up and even on the highest setting, it's still pretty quiet. I've also noticed I've woken up less stuffy than I normally would have, so this actually does work. I'll definitely be buying a second one for my home gym room.", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Jared Batiste", "review_title": "Perfect for a Bedroom", "review_text": "I’ve been really happy with this little air purifier. とても静かである。
初日は、新車の中のような匂いがあったが、2日目は気にならない。設置してからは、症状も出ていない。", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Candy", "review_title": "Best buy", "review_text": "It's a great find❤️❤️❤️", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Mary", "review_title": "حلو بدون سلك", "review_text": "بدون سلك كهرباء", "review_rating": ""}, {"reviewer_name": "Giulio", "review_title": "Piccolo e silenzioso", "review_text": "È piccolo, perciò non ci si può aspettare miracoli, ma se vengono rispettate le indicazioni del produttore utilizzandolo in stanze delle adeguate dimensioni, lavora benissimo, e purifica l'aria correttamente. Perfino il filtro sembra essere ben costruito e di qualità superiore rispetto ad altri della stessa fascia di prezzo. Ha una regolazione di 3 velocità delle quali solo la massima è rumorosa ma non molto fastidiosa, infatti la velocità intermedia è appena udibile (pari ad un soffio) e mai fastidiosa anche stando nelle vicinanze.
